Amumu.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no spell to create distance on his own, so if you have a wall angle, catch him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and pull him toward your team with Skarner R Impale.
Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, he can follow up after stunning you, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns all nearby enemies, so don’t group with your allies while he has R available; keep your distance in open terrain. After he gets on top of you, adjust your distance so you don’t take damage from Amumu W Despair, which scales with maximum health, for too long.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance first against Amumu’s magic damage and include Spirit Visage in your core item path. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone. Amumu P Cursed Touch’s true damage can’t be reduced with magic resistance, so build some health too.
Amumu.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to push Amumu into a wall and stun him, then stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to pull Amumu toward your team when your allies can deal damage right away. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Amumu’s damage hits.
Amumu.fight: Engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Approach from behind terrain with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and knock Amumu into a wall. While you’re on top of him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Adjust your distance so you don’t trade while taking Amumu W Despair’s damage for too long.
Amumu.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kill attempts.
Amumu.phase: After that, build items safely, take control of objectives, and pull in targets your allies can attack right away during teamfights.
Amumu.teamfight: If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and fight in open terrain. Buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval before Amumu gets on top of you. Look for an angle to suppress Amumu with Skarner R Impale and pull him into your team when he tries to engage. If your allied damage dealers aren’t in position to deal damage immediately, save Skarner R Impale and hold out with Skarner W Seismic Bastion.

Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth is at her weakest early, before she has growth stacks, so keep to a safe jungle route and look for chances to disrupt her growth. In the mid game, once Skarner R Impale is available, you can gank even without a wall. Bel’Veth becomes harder to fight as she gains permanent growth stacks in the late game, so delay teamfights while she is transformed.
Belveth.build: Bel’Veth’s main abilities, Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom, deal physical damage, so build armor first. Attack speed is important for her, so consider Frozen Heart to reduce the basic attacks you take while pulling her in with Skarner R Impale. Bel’Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage can’t be stopped with resistances, so build health too.
Belveth.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. After dodging Bel’Veth W Above and Below, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, knock her into a wall to stun her, and fully stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Q. When your allies are in position to deal damage, use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull her in, then turn in the opposite direction just before it ends to send her farther into your team’s formation.
Belveth.escape: Bel’Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so she can’t immediately dash again in the direction she just dashed. If you also dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact while her pursuit is slowed. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress her when you can chain crowd control.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, then approach with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when she can’t use Bel’Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction she just dashed. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits.
Belveth.laning: Bel’Veth is weak early and has no growth stacks, so look for chances to steal camps and large monsters. Look for ganks in open areas once Skarner R Impale is available.
Belveth.teamfight: When your allied damage dealers can attack right away, use Skarner R Impale to pull Bel’Veth into your team and create a numbers advantage. If you don’t have that angle, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If an ally dies and drops a Void Coral, retreat before Bel’Veth can pick it up, and don’t fight again while she is transformed.
Belveth.watch: If Bel’Veth W Above and Below hits you, it knocks you up and resets the cooldown of Bel’Veth Q Void Surge. When Bel’Veth gets on top of you, sidestep instead of running straight backward to dodge W. Bel’Veth takes greatly reduced damage during E Royal Maelstrom, so save your spells until it ends or interrupt it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.

Briar.fight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy/Snack Attack is active, she targets the nearest enemy, so stand in front to keep her from reaching your allied damage dealers. When fighting up close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Briar’s damage hits to absorb it with your shield. Only use Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval again to throw a rock if Briar creates enough distance that you can’t land empowered basic attacks.
Briar.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kills. Prepare for Briar’s ganks by securing vision on the side where your lane is pushed, and don’t linger in the middle of a lane where you have no vision. When ganking, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact from the opposite side so you can slam the enemy into a wall on the inside of the lane.
Briar.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Briar P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy/Snack Attack. Briar W Blood Frenzy/Snack Attack increases attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart. If the fight will last a long time, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances. Health items also strengthen Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
Briar.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to push Briar into the wall behind her and stun her, and stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while she is stunned. When your allies are in position to attack right away, use Skarner R Impale to suppress Briar and pull her toward your team.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. She can also move with Briar W Blood Frenzy/Snack Attack or R Certain Death, so look in particular for a chance to close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact before Briar R Certain Death comes back up. If Briar starts charging E Chilling Scream, find an angle to stun her against a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and prevent the heal and wall stun.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has a high chance of getting takedowns, and Skarner’s ganks depend on having a wall stun angle, so focus on farming safely. Later, Skarner’s shield and damage grow as he builds health and core items, so buy time and take control of objectives.
Briar.teamfight: Stand on the front line in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy/Snack Attack’s dash to protect your allied damage dealers, and intercept the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death from the front as well. If your allies can deal damage immediately when Briar engages, use Skarner R Impale to suppress her and pull her into your team. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns you, and lowers your armor and magic resistance, so don’t fight back for long right after it hits. When Briar starts charging E Chilling Scream, look for an angle to stun her against a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, and don’t stand with your back to a wall where her fully charged scream can knock you into it. Stand in front of your allied damage dealers because Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone marks the first champion it hits.

Aatrox.teamfight: Buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion while checking whether your allied damage dealers are in position to attack right away. If the conditions are right, use Skarner R Impale to suppress Aatrox or an enemy on top of an allied damage dealer, then pull them into your team. Avoid long duels while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against Aatrox’s main damage from Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with Skarner’s maximum health, so health items are useful too. If the duel lasts a long time, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistances.
Aatrox.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. After Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, knock him into a wall to stun him, and fully stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Q. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies are in position to deal damage right away.
Aatrox.escape: Aatrox E Umbral Dash is an opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact right after he uses it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to get out of its area before you’re pulled back. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, delay your engage and go back in after it expires.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and line up a wall behind the enemy. Once you’re on top of them, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, farm safely without giving Aatrox a kill. In open areas with no wall, Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact cannot stun, so avoid forcing an engage. When you see Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade’s cast, dodge the blade tip and look for a chance to trade.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Aatrox can become strong quickly if he gets an advantage, so farm without giving him a kill. Your prospects in fights improve as Skarner builds items, so get through the early game safely.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade’s blade tip is dangerous, so when you see the cast animation, dodge outside its edge or move in close.

Diana.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. After Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam her into a wall and stun her, then land an empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies are in position to deal damage, use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull her toward them.
Diana.watch: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike by moving sideways; it curves as it travels. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can have its cooldown reset, so create distance. Right after Diana W Pale Cascade is activated, don’t fight up close until its shield and spheres disappear.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first against Diana’s damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. It also helps Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield, making it a good fit against her.
Diana.escape: If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again, so don’t engage and create distance. Right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without a mark, you can close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch her with Skarner R Impale.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana uses E Lunar Rush to engage without a mark, catch her with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or the wall stun from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Activate Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before taking damage.
Diana.laning: Skarner should safely clear camps early and build levels and items.
Diana.phase: After that, buy time to complete items and look for objective control.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to block Diana’s flank angles, and spread out so multiple allies aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall. If Diana dives onto an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel her off. If your allies aren’t in position to deal damage immediately, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and W Seismic Bastion.

Fiora.watch: While Fiora W Riposte is available, don’t rush either of your two abilities. Even after she uses it, keep moving sideways to avoid her counterattack. If you’re hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to block one side’s vital.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Since Fiora E Bladework increases attack speed, consider Frozen Heart. Resistance cannot mitigate the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge. If the duel drags on, consider Grievous Wounds after resistances.
Fiora.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. After Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to knock Fiora into a wall and stun her, then follow up with Skarner Q Shattered Earth's empowered attacks. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and drag her toward them.
Fiora.escape: Immediately after you force Fiora to use Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, catch her with Skarner R Impale so she has no chance to escape.
Fiora.fight: Stand opposite the side where Fiora’s vital appears, and briefly trade back when she dives in. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow, and don’t chase recklessly after the trade. If Fiora W Riposte is still available, save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale.
Fiora.laning: In the jungle, clear camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing early kills. When ganking Fiora, first choose which wall to knock her into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Fiora.phase: As Skarner completes items, both his defenses and damage increase.
Fiora.teamfight: Once Fiora W Riposte is down and your allied damage dealers can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Fiora into your team. If those conditions aren’t met, buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and save your suppression.

RekSai.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push Rek'Sai into the wall behind her and stun her, then build stacks of Skarner P Threads of Vibration with empowered attacks. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress and pull her with Skarner R Impale, then turn your body in the opposite direction just before the duration ends.
RekSai.fight: Avoid forced fights early, and close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact after Rek'Sai’s mobility ability is down. Once close, keep landing empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to use its max-health damage and slow. Throw a rock when Rek'Sai moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Rek'Sai’s damage lands to benefit from the shield.
RekSai.teamfight: If Rek'Sai dives onto an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to suppress her and peel her off. If you’re positioned so your allies can deal damage immediately, pull Rek'Sai into your team to create a numbers advantage. If that condition isn’t met, hold Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rek’Sai Q Queen’s Wrath / Prey Seeker and Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Consider Frozen Heart because basic attacks and attack speed are central to her damage. Use health to withstand the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but don’t stack large amounts of health alone because Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your max health.
RekSai.escape: After dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, she has no way to catch you, so look for an opening to engage. Don’t go in just because Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down; wait until she has also used Rek’Sai R Void Rush, before it’s available again. Then approach with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and suppress her with Skarner R Impale.
RekSai.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to gain levels and items, and don’t move alone where you lack vision. If you see an entrance to Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel in lane or your jungle, walk over it to destroy it. When ganking, first choose the wall to knock the target into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If there’s no wall angle in the lane, look for a gank once Skarner R Impale is available.
RekSai.phase: Early on, watch out for Rek’Sai looking to build an advantage through ganks, and don’t give up kills. Afterward, safely buy time to build items and look for objective control.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai goes underground with W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch for the knock-up, and move toward open space with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact as she emerges. Immediately after being hit by Rek’Sai’s poke, stay close to an ally because Rek’Sai R Void Rush may follow, and don’t use targeted abilities while she’s leaping.

Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to keep him from building Fury by hitting minions. If you see him building Fury, create distance before he gets close. When retreating from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him. If there’s no angle to push him into a wall, it’s hard to land a stun with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, so avoid forcing an engage.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Skarner should scale safely while watching out for Tryndamere’s Fury and critical strikes.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury builds up, his critical strikes become dangerous and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust heals more. Create distance when he starts hitting minions to build Fury. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t die, so let time pass with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale instead of pouring on damage.
Tryndamere.build: Build armor first because Tryndamere’s main damage is physical. Thornmail is effective against an opponent who relies on basic attacks. Health items also increase Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
Tryndamere.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, push him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact so there’s a wall behind him, stun him, then land empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you force Tryndamere to use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your opening to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Around many minions, Tryndamere’s critical strikes make Tryndamere E Spinning Slash come back off cooldown quickly, so lure him to an area without minions or hit him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and Skarner R Impale right after his mobility ability is spent.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Once in range, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Tryndamere moves out of range. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, hold on and slow him with Skarner W Seismic Bastion; wait for its duration to end before focusing your damage on him.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Hold the frontline with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion while watching for Tryndamere to engage. If he reaches an allied damage dealer, peel him off with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or Skarner R Impale. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with suppression and choose a target to pull when your allies can deal damage immediately.

Irelia.laning: Afterward, don’t leave a low-health minion between you and the other champion, and step back when a minion is about to die. For early ganks, Skarner should prioritize lanes where he can angle an enemy into a wall.
Irelia.build: Build armor first against Irelia’s main damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Irelia P Ionian Fervor increases her attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart. Health items also strengthen Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
Irelia.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster in advance. Carry Irelia into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun her, then land the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. Suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward your team when they can attack immediately.
Irelia.escape: The window to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down and hasn’t reset. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is down too, there will be less crowd control to stop your engage. If Skarner R Impale is ready, you can grab her and prevent her from escaping with Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.fight: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth before engaging. After Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge and it doesn’t reset, approach with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Slam her into a wall to stun her, then follow up with empowered attacks. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the opponent’s damage hits to gain its shield.
Irelia.phase: Late game, Skarner’s defensive items also contribute to his damage and shield, so buy time and scale.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia, since Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet let her have a big impact in teamfights. If your damage dealers can attack immediately, grab her with Skarner R Impale and pull her into your team. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close in, so back away as minions are about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Khazix.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe scaling and securing objective control rather than forcing kills. From mid game, when Kha'Zix has at least two evolutions, stop acting alone; Skarner should buy time to reach his item spikes.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with maximum health, so get health items too.
Khazix.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Kha'Zix E Leap is down, close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, slam him into a wall to stun him, and build Quaking stacks with empowered Q basic attacks. When an ally can deal damage immediately, suppress Kha'Zix with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them.
Khazix.escape: The moment after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is your chance to counterattack. Save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale until then, and use them to close in and suppress him. If Kha'Zix has evolved E and gets a takedown, it can reset, so don’t expect the same opening after an ally is picked off.
Khazix.fight: Don’t fight Kha'Zix alone; stay with allies to reduce his isolation damage. After Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage, push him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while you’re on top of him.
Khazix.laning: Safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items early, then look for lanes where Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has an angle to slam an enemy into a wall. Don’t let Kha'Zix read your solo jungle path, and keep vision in the river and jungle entrance brush.
Khazix.teamfight: Group closely with your allies and fight in a narrow area where you have vision, and stay near your backline damage dealers so they aren’t isolated. If Kha'Zix leaps in, catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or R Impale. If an ally can’t deal damage immediately, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage to isolated targets, so stay near allies or minions. If Kha'Zix vanishes with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay with your allies instead of chasing his position, then lock him down when he reappears.

Akali.build: Build Spirit Visage in your core item path and increase your magic resistance against Akali’s damage. Health also strengthens Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and delays entering Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute threshold. Akali has relatively high magic resistance, so consider penetration to deal more damage.
Akali.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Once Akali’s mobility spells are down and you have a wall angle, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, knock her into a wall to stun her, then land an empowered basic attack from Q. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress her and pull her toward your team when your allies can deal damage immediately.
Akali.escape: After you dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali W Twilight Shroud is down, look for an engage. Check whether she still has another mobility spell, and close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, then use Skarner R Impale.
Akali.fight: Don’t rush in with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact while Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution are available. If Akali comes out of her shroud to attack, use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits, then retaliate with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Akali.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items. In open areas, you’ll need to rely on the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and your allies’ crowd control.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, once Skarner R Impale is available, you can look for suppression ganks regardless of terrain. In the late game, focus on tanking with Skarner’s defensive items and pulling in priority targets.
Akali.teamfight: If Akali gets on top of an allied damage dealer, prioritize peeling her off with Skarner R Impale. If your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, suppress Akali and pull her into your team. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and save R.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash will follow Skarner as he retreats. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to respond, and watch for the second hit when a large amount of health has been lost.

Aurora.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurora’s main damage, and include Spirit Visage in your core item path. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building only health.
Aurora.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to push Aurora into the wall behind her and stun her, then land an empowered basic attack. Use Skarner R Impale to pull her toward your team when your allies can attack right away. If Aurora gets out of range, throw a rock with Skarner Q Upheaval.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds too. In particular, close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are both down, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up. Then suppress her with Skarner R Impale so she can’t escape with a mobility spell.
Aurora.fight: Avoid long trades that involve taking the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex while health is already reduced. Make Aurora use E The Weirding to create distance, check for any remaining mobility spells, then get back on top of her with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits to benefit from both its shield and slow.
Aurora.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps safely to gain levels and items. When ganking Aurora, first pick a wall to push her into, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact from the opposite side.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Skarner needs a wall angle to stun, so focus on farming safely. The more defensive items Skarner builds in the late game, the stronger his shield and damage become, so look for objective control and teamfights.
Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora jumps in but doesn’t get a takedown, take that moment as an opportunity to get on top of her. Use Skarner R Impale to pull in a priority target when your allies can attack immediately, or to peel an enemy off an allied damage dealer. When retreating, Aurora’s jump cooldown may reset, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases as your health gets lower. If you’re cursed, move out of the line connecting you to Aurora, and retreat before the recall if your health is in a precarious spot. You’ll be slowed if you leave Aurora R Between Worlds after it appears, so either leave before the area forms or find an angle to fight inside it.

Brand.build: Brand’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core item path. Brand P Blaze scales with maximum health, so building magic resistance is better than adding only health.
Brand.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, knock Brand into a wall to stun him, and immediately stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can deal damage.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spells, so using Brand W Pillar of Flame is an opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact right after. If you aren’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you. If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before engaging.
Brand.fight: Engage when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand Q Sear can no longer stun you. Close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and knock him into a wall. Once you’re on top of him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits to absorb it with your shield.
Brand.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps safely to gain levels and items, and take control of objectives. When ganking a lane with Brand, first find an angle to go over a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and knock Brand into a wall on the inside of the lane.
Brand.phase: Early on, Skarner needs a wall angle to stun, so focus on safe jungle play. Skarner gets stronger in the late game with core items, but spread out in teamfights so Brand’s area damage doesn’t spread.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies before engaging to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the chain damage from Brand R Pyroclasm. If your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to suppress Brand and pull him into your team. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you’re hit by spells in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge his first spell. Move out of Brand W Pillar of Flame, and if you’re ablaze, dodge the projectile line from Brand Q Sear or stand behind a minion. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies.

Camille.build: Build armor first against the damage from Camille’s main abilities. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage isn’t reduced by armor, but Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building a large amount of health alone. Consider Frozen Heart against the attack speed increase from Camille E Hookshot and the strength of her basic attacks.
Camille.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before engaging. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, knock Camille into a wall to stun her, then fully stack Skarner P Threads of Vibration with empowered basic attacks from Q. When your allies can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Camille toward your team, then turn in the opposite direction just before its duration ends.
Camille.escape: Once Camille E Hookshot is down, you have an opportunity to close the distance with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is available, she can use it to escape too, so look especially for an opening after R is down or before it comes back up. Suppress her with Skarner R Impale then so she can’t escape with a mobility spell.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. After the shield is stripped away, stick to one target to build stacks of Skarner P Threads of Vibration. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second basic attack hits to benefit from its shield and slow. When you’re on top of her, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Camille gets out of range.
Camille.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items, and look for a gank before Camille gets her first core item. Watch for Camille E Hookshot engaging from a wall, and when ganking, first pick a wall to slam Camille into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Camille.phase: Early on, Camille is weak before her first core item and clears lanes slowly, but Skarner should also focus on farming safely instead of forcing early kills. From the mid game onward, Camille can quickly destroy side-lane turrets, so don’t leave a side lane unattended. Buy time for Skarner to build items and take control of objectives.
Camille.teamfight: If Camille uses E Hookshot to get on top of an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel her off. When you start a fight, use R to pull Camille into your team from a position where your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. Otherwise, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to engage from a long distance and stun you, so don’t let yourself get pushed toward a wall. The second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol includes true damage, so create distance while she prepares it. Don’t use a response spell as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum brings her in; first dodge her incoming E Hookshot or W Tactical Sweep.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Cho'Gath R Feast’s true damage can’t be reduced with resistances, and stacking a lot of health also increases the max-health-based damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Chogath.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to drag Cho'Gath into the wall behind him and stun him, then continue with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so right after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave or you dodge it, you have an opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Enter after dodging the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream as well to reduce the risk of your mobility being blocked.
Chogath.fight: Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture to the side, and fight at an angle so you don’t get hit by Cho'Gath W Feral Scream from the front. After Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to find an approach angle toward a wall. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands to benefit from the shield.
Chogath.laning: Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions to poke, so step out of the line of Cho'Gath’s basic attacks. Pressure from outside Cho'Gath Q Rupture’s range, and look for a gank angle that lets you slam him into a wall right after he uses Q Rupture on the wave. Slow his growth from the start, but don’t give up a kill when health is borderline.
Chogath.phase: Pressure Cho'Gath early to slow his growth, but focus Skarner’s ganks on angles near walls and safely build levels and items. The matchup becomes less favorable over time because of Cho'Gath’s Feast stacks, so don’t give up kills, and prepare for teamfights by completing Skarner’s core items.
Chogath.teamfight: If your damage dealers are positioned to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a key target into your team and create a numbers advantage. If Cho'Gath is on top of an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel him off. If your allies can’t follow up, save R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and W Seismic Bastion.
Chogath.watch: When Cho'Gath Q Rupture’s ground warning appears beneath you, dodge to the side and save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact for that moment. If you’re caught by the silence in front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, walk out of its range first. If you’re at or below half health, create distance to avoid the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Darius E Apprehend ignores some armor, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so build health as well. Health also helps Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
Darius.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Darius E Apprehend is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to engage and stun Darius by slamming him into the wall behind him, then land an empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Darius.escape: The window to engage is when Darius E Apprehend has been used into empty space or is on cooldown. You can also poke briefly right after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions.
Darius.fight: Only trade briefly after Darius E Apprehend is down, and back off before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up. If you can stay close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use the recast throw when Darius moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Darius’s damage lands to benefit from the shield.
Darius.laning: Safely clear camps early and build levels and items. When ganking Darius, check whether Darius E Apprehend is down, then find an angle to use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam him into a wall on the inside of the lane. You can’t stun him in open areas, so avoid forced ganks until Skarner R Impale is available.
Darius.phase: Darius is strong in early skirmishes and dives, so Skarner should focus on safely farming. Skarner grows stronger in the late game as he completes health and core items, so prepare for objectives and teamfights.
Darius.teamfight: If health has dropped with several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage present, retreat completely so Darius R Noxian Guillotine can’t secure a kill and give him another opportunity to cast it. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress Darius and pull him into your team when your damage dealers can attack immediately. If that angle isn’t available, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Darius.watch: If you’re pulled in by Darius E Apprehend, Darius can follow with a basic attack, W Crippling Strike, and Q Decimate, so wait outside its range and save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to respond. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or hug him closely to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to let them expire; if health has dropped with several stacks present, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Consider magic resistance if the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper becomes a large part of his damage. If the duel goes long, get resistances before picking up Grievous Wounds.
DrMundo.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth in advance on a minion or jungle monster, then use E Ixtal's Impact to drag Dr. Mundo toward a wall. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so confirm that E has consumed his passive before suppressing him with Skarner R Impale. During that time, stack Quaking on one target with empowered Q basic attacks, and when you pull him with R, move toward a position where your allies can deal damage immediately.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when you find a wall angle to get close. Block the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions, and look for the sequence of using Skarner R Impale after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. The window after Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down is a good time to look for a kill.
DrMundo.fight: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth in advance and approach to deal max-health-based damage with empowered basic attacks. While you’re close, use all the empowered Q attacks, and throw the rock only when Dr. Mundo moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma lands to gain a shield and slow him.
DrMundo.laning: Early on, safely clear camps and build levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, first find an angle to push Dr. Mundo toward a wall on the inside of the lane with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw by keeping minions between you, and retreat by stepping on the canister Mundo drops after a trade.
DrMundo.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe camp routes and objective control rather than kills.
DrMundo.teamfight: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, don’t use Skarner R Impale first. After the passive is down, use R to pull a target your allies can attack immediately into your team and create a numbers advantage. If that angle isn’t available, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and W Seismic Bastion.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful at high health and dodge it from behind minions. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t use Skarner R Impale first while his passive is available. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, it’s better not to spend time trying to kill him because of its healing and movement speed increase.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko’s damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Health items also help Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal's Impact.
Ekko.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun Ekko by slamming him into a wall, then stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull him toward your allies when they can deal damage immediately.
Ekko.escape: A good window to engage is after Ekko W Parallel Convergence is down and before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up. If he has just used E Phase Dive as well, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale. If only one of Ekko’s mobility abilities is down, check for his remaining mobility before engaging.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with E Phase Dive, his mobility is down, so stun him by pushing him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or suppress him with Skarner R Impale. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t commit to the first engage; fight in earnest after he uses it. While close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw the rock when Ekko moves out of range.
Ekko.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early and build levels and items. When ganking, first find an angle to cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and slam Ekko into a wall on the inside of the lane.
Ekko.phase: Skarner should focus on safe growth instead of forcing early kills. He gets stronger as he completes core items, so buy time for mid-to-late-game fights and secure objective control.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko uses E Phase Dive to get onto an ally, peel him off with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or R Impale. If your allies can attack the target caught by Skarner R Impale immediately, pull it into your team and create a numbers advantage. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and W Seismic Bastion.
Ekko.watch: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid both the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder flies and also step away from its return path. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even at low health.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Elise W Skittering Frenzy increases her attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart as well.
Elise.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam Elise into a wall and stun her, then stack Quaking with empowered Q basic attacks. Once your allies are in range, suppress and pull her with Skarner R Impale.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise uses Q Venomous Bite, there’s an opportunity to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch her with Skarner R Impale. If both Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are down, turn on her, and while she’s airborne from E Rappel, check where she’ll land before engaging.
Elise.fight: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth in advance, then find an angle that puts a wall behind Elise and engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once you’re close, land all the empowered Q basic attacks and gain a shield with Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands.
Elise.laning: Early on, get vision so Elise can’t secure kills with ganks, and don’t push the lane recklessly when she’s missing.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch out for Elise trying to build an advantage with ganks, and focus on safe growth as Skarner.
Elise.teamfight: If your allies are positioned to deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Elise or an opponent who has engaged on an allied damage dealer away from them. Otherwise, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and W Seismic Bastion.
Elise.watch: If Elise transforms with R Spider Form after health has decreased, she may look for a finishing blow, so be ready to use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and W Seismic Bastion.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Evelynn W Allure lowers magic resistance and Evelynn E Whiplash deals max-health-based damage, so prioritize retreating before the mark matures over stacking health alone.
Evelynn.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to drag Evelynn into a wall and stun her, then stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress and pull her toward your allies when they can attack immediately.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. Look for the window before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and suppress her with Skarner R Impale. Don’t use Skarner W Seismic Bastion before engaging; use it when Evelynn’s damage lands.
Evelynn.fight: While the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing, create distance instead of fighting back. Before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when your allies can attack with you. Once close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw the rock only when Evelynn moves out of range.
Evelynn.laning: When ganking, first choose a wall to push the opponent into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then engage. Bring Control Wards and place vision around the jungle camps where Evelynn may start a fight.
Evelynn.phase: In the late game, use the synergy between Skarner’s defensive items and abilities to hold off Evelynn’s engage beside your allies.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn may dive your backline, so keep Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale ready where your allies have vision. Catch her right after she engages, peel her off your damage dealers, and attack together. If your allies aren’t positioned to attack immediately, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Evelynn.watch: If you’re marked by Evelynn W Allure, retreat into allied vision before the charm completes and send a danger signal. The damage from Evelynn E Whiplash after the charm is high, so use Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield just before it lands. At low health, beware the heavy damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and don’t stay in areas without vision.

Fiddlesticks.build: Build magic resistance first against Fiddlesticks’ damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield just before damage lands.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun Fiddlesticks by slamming him into a wall, then land an empowered Q basic attack. When your allies can attack, pull him in with Skarner R Impale.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Fiddlesticks has no mobility ability while R Crowstorm is down, so engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact during that window. If you can’t interrupt R, get out of its area first so you don’t remain there while controlled by Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and E Reap.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest’s channel with your saved E or Skarner R Impale when it begins.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items instead of forcing kills.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the bushes and approaches around objectives, and spread out so you aren’t all hit by Fiddlesticks’ area abilities. When you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm being cast, interrupt it with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. Use R to pull Fiddlesticks into your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm engages after channeling, so interrupt it with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale when you see the cast. If you can’t interrupt it, get out of range; when Fiddlesticks has been missing for a long time, beware of bushes without vision and narrow paths.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Also build health to withstand true damage and strengthen Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
Gangplank.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push him into a wall and stun him, land an empowered Q attack, then use Skarner R Impale to pull him toward your allies as they follow up.
Gangplank.escape: Your chance to engage comes just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, while it’s still fresh, or after a keg is destroyed. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, but if Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, bait it out before using your key crowd control.
Gangplank.fight: Close the gap just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or immediately after a keg is destroyed. Once in range, land all the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, first choose a route that lets you knock Gangplank into the wall on the inner side of the lane, and delay your engage if an aged Gangplank E Powder Keg is nearby.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, Skarner should farm safely and only look for ganks when there’s an angle to knock the target into a wall. In the late game, complete Skarner’s core items to buy time in fights.
Gangplank.teamfight: Buy time by avoiding aged Gangplank E Powder Kegs and using the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If your allies are in position to deal damage immediately and Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, use Skarner R Impale to pull Gangplank into your team.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes dangerous as it ages, so destroy it from outside its blast radius and don’t step into overlapping kegs.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice can’t be reduced by resistances, so build health as well. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with Skarner’s maximum health.
Garen.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. After Garen Q Decisive Strike is spent and the brief window after Garen W Courage has passed, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push Garen into the wall behind him and stun him.
Garen.escape: Your chance to engage comes just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used on a minion or otherwise spent. If Garen W Courage is active, wait for its brief initial window to pass, then catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so once caught, he has no way out until he uses Flash.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is spent. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, don’t stay in close combat; leave its radius. Don’t immediately commit Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale right after Garen W Courage activates.
Garen.laning: Early on, push the lane or apply pressure so Garen has no chance to stack up. Skarner should still prioritize safe growth over forcing early kills, and look for ganks when there’s an angle to knock Garen into a wall. In open areas, Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can’t stun him, so use the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and your allies’ crowd control.
Garen.phase: Pressure Garen early to slow his growth, but Skarner should prioritize safe growth and opportunities to use walls over forcing kills. Garen W Courage’s permanent stacks remain forever, so fighting Garen becomes harder as the game goes on.
Garen.teamfight: Buy time up front with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion, then use Skarner R Impale to pull Garen into your team when your allies can attack immediately. Don’t rush your suppression right after Garen W Courage. You can also use Skarner R Impale to peel Garen off an allied damage dealer.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack silences, so don’t engage first while it’s active. Don’t stay in Garen E Judgment’s spin for long, and delay your crowd control briefly right after Garen W Courage. If you’re below half health, get out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to mitigate Gnar’s main damage. Consider Frozen Heart in response to the attack speed increases from Gnar P Rage Gene and Gnar E Hop/Crunch. Gnar W Hyper/Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t focus only on building health.
Gnar.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval in advance on a minion or jungle monster. Once Gnar E Hop/Crunch is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to knock him into a wall and stun him, then land the empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress Gnar with Skarner R Impale and drag him toward them, turning around just before it ends to increase the distance you pull him.
Gnar.escape: Immediately after you force Gnar to use Gnar E Hop/Crunch is your chance to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Fight up close right after Mega Gnar reverts to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again. Don’t meet him head-on just after he transforms into Mega Gnar; create distance.
Gnar.fight: Fight right after Mega Gnar reverts to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again. Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, close in, and land all its empowered attacks. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Gnar’s damage hits to benefit from its shield and slow.
Gnar.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items. When ganking, first choose a wall to push Gnar into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Don’t force early ganks in open areas where there’s no angle to knock him into a wall.
Gnar.phase: Early on, Skarner should clear camps safely and grow instead of forcing kills. Skarner gets stronger as he completes items, so buy time, but avoid fights in tight terrain where Mega Gnar can land Gnar R GNAR! effectively.
Gnar.teamfight: Watch Gnar’s Rage bar and start a team fight just after he reverts from Mega to Mini Gnar. Don’t stand with your back to a wall. When an allied damage dealer is in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team. If that condition isn’t met, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw/Boulder Toss can hit you both on the way out and on the way back in Mini Gnar form, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns targets knocked into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one.

Gragas.build: Build magic resistance first against Gragas’s damage, and prioritize Spirit Visage among your core items. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so magic resistance matters more than focusing only on health.
Gragas.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to close in, knock Gragas into a wall and stun him, then land the empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them.
Gragas.escape: Your chance to engage comes immediately after you force Gragas to use Gragas E Body Slam. Close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale. Don’t chase a fleeing Gragas deep if you can’t secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: Don’t commit heavy damage while Gragas is drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage; wait for its effect to end. If you’re in range, land all the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Gragas moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Gragas’s damage hits to benefit from its shield.
Gragas.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items. When ganking, first choose a wall to push Gragas into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Gragas.phase: Early on, Skarner’s ganks depend on having an angle to use a wall, so farm safely. Gragas has strong burst and disruption in the early and mid game, so hold your formation and endure during objective fights.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your backline alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and be wary of narrow paths and brush without vision. If Gragas engages, you can use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and peel him off your allied damage dealers. If your allies aren’t in position to deal damage immediately, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Gragas.watch: If you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, immediately leave its radius. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you’ll take both abilities, so don’t stand there and trade back. When Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps earlier and build armor first. Skarner W Seismic Bastion grants a shield based on maximum health, so build health items later as well.
Graves.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to cross terrain, drag Graves into a wall, and stun him, then follow up with the empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them.
Graves.escape: Don’t engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Look for a chance before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, and while his mobility is down, approach with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and use Skarner R Impale. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, first leave its radius and regain vision, then re-engage.
Graves.fight: Trade back or close the gap while Graves reloads after firing two shots. After Graves R Collateral Damage is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and if Graves E Quickdraw is also down, catch him with Skarner R Impale. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Graves’s damage hits to benefit from its shield.
Graves.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kills. Pressure Graves to limit the time he has to build his growth stacks, but when ganking, first choose the wall to knock him into and the direction of approach for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Graves.phase: Early on, Skarner should farm safely while using pressure to limit the time Graves has to build stacks. In the mid game, Skarner R Impale opens up more gank angles, so look for fights while Graves’s mobility is down. As the game goes on, Graves’s accumulated growth puts you at a disadvantage, so complete your items and focus on catching targets with your allies.
Graves.teamfight: Use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team when your allied damage dealer is in position to deal damage immediately. You can turn around just before the suppression ends to pull Graves farther in. If your allies can’t follow up, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle path. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its radius by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves’s basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so keep minions or allies between you.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, and prioritize Spirit Visage among your core items. Build some armor to withstand her basic attacks too, but dodge the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! by repositioning rather than relying on resistances.
Gwen.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. Once Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push her into the wall behind her and stun her, then build up Quaking stacks with the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. When your allies follow up, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her in.
Gwen.escape: Immediately after you force Gwen to use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is your window to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If you’re slowed by Gwen R Needlework or standing in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, first adjust your angle and distance.
Gwen.fight: Early on, trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds up stacks, and don’t engage when she has full stacks. Once Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and when Gwen casts Gwen Q Snip Snip!, step sideways out of the center.
Gwen.laning: Stay outside Gwen’s basic attack range to limit her chances to heal from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come off cooldown more easily near a large minion wave, so draw her toward a wall away from minions to find an angle for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Gwen.teamfight: If Gwen gets onto an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel her off. When your allies can attack immediately, pull Gwen into your team. If that condition isn’t met, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and the shield from Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so step sideways as she casts to get out of the center. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay in close combat for long after building only health.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with his maximum health, so build health items too.
Hecarim.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to cross terrain and knock Hecarim into a wall to stun him, then fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so track both movement abilities. In particular, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and suppress him with Skarner R Impale before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, slow Hecarim first with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner W Seismic Bastion to reduce his approach and damage. If you’re in range, land all the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Hecarim moves out of range.
Hecarim.laning: When ganking, first choose the wall to knock your target into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Hecarim.phase: Afterward, grow safely, complete defensive items, and look to gain control of objectives.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can’t fear several of you. If Hecarim engages, slow him first with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If he gets onto an allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel him off. Pull the suppressed target into your team when your allies can deal damage to that target immediately.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he runs, so if he circles around to the opposite side and runs, break vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so spread out from one another in team fights.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. If you need to account for her healing in a fight, apply Grievous Wounds early with Executioner's Calling.
Illaoi.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. Once Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun her by slamming her into the wall behind her.
Illaoi.escape: Right after you bait Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your window to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If you’ve also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, you can close the gap without worrying about its slow and mark. Suppress her with Skarner R Impale to leave her less room to escape.
Illaoi.fight: Don’t fight where tentacles are set up; draw Illaoi into open ground. Right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once you’re on her, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits to benefit from its shield and slow.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave from being pulled near a wall, and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. If there’s a tentacle near a wall, destroy it or move out of that area. If you can’t fight after your soul is taken, break the link, dodge the first tentacle, then wait beside it for the mark to expire.
Illaoi.phase: Illaoi is strong near her tentacles early, and Skarner needs an angle to slam her into a wall and stun her with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Skarner gets stronger as he builds defensive items, but even late, avoid the tentacle zone while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.teamfight: Spread out rather than grouping in front of Illaoi, since grouping lets Illaoi R Leap of Faith create more tentacles, and keep your distance while her ultimate lasts. Fight after destroying the tentacles or drawing Illaoi into open ground. Use Skarner R Impale to pull a target toward your team when your damage dealers can attack immediately. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit leaves a slow and mark, so move outside its range to dodge it. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, spread out and stay clear of the tentacle zone until it ends. Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God heals more as her health gets lower, so don’t dive just because she’s at half health.

Ivern.build: Ivern’s threat comes from allies following up on the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!, so you can prioritize tenacity. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, build magic resistance and include Spirit Visage in your core item order. Health items also help Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Ivern.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun the opponent by slamming them into the wall behind them.
Ivern.escape: Right after Ivern’s mobility tool, Ivern Q Rootcaller, is down is your window to approach with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If the target is affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait until the shield bursts and applies its slow before going in. Once you’ve grabbed them, suppress them with Skarner R Impale to leave them less room to escape.
Ivern.fight: Right after forcing Ivern to use Ivern Q Rootcaller, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If the target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, delay your engage until the shield bursts. Once you’re on them, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only if the opponent moves out of range.
Ivern.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and build levels and items instead of forcing kills. Ward Ivern’s jungle to track when he comes to harvest camps where he planted seeds, and look for angles to cross a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Before ganking, pick the wall you’ll slam the opponent into, then approach from the opposite side.
Ivern.phase: Late game, Skarner’s shield and damage both grow as he gains levels and defensive items, so look for picks with your team.
Ivern.teamfight: If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, don’t waste abilities on opponents behind her, and keep moving so Daisy can’t hit you repeatedly. Instead of chasing Ivern deep, pick off an ally he shields, but engage after the shield bursts. Use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target in when your damage dealers can deal damage immediately. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, allies can charge in, so keep a minion or terrain between you and him before he throws it. Don’t engage on a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed right away; wait for the shield to burst and apply its slow before going in. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid being hit three times in a row and knocked up.

JarvanIV.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. When your allies are in position to attack immediately, suppress the target with Skarner R Impale, pull them toward your team, and turn your body the other way just before the duration ends.
JarvanIV.fight: After taking that basic attack, you can take a trade.
JarvanIV.laning: Skarner should clear jungle camps safely, build levels and items, and look for objective control.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Suppress the target and pull them into your team when your damage dealers can attack immediately. If they aren’t in position, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.

Jax.build: Jax P Relentless Assault increases his attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart. Jax deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so don’t lean too heavily into one type of resistance. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core item order.
Jax.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. After Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, stun him by slamming him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Jax.escape: Right after forcing Jax to use Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t rush your mobility ability; wait outside the stun radius for it to end. Engage during the window when both abilities are down and grab him with Skarner R Impale.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Stop empowered attacks while Counter Strike is active, use Skarner W Seismic Bastion for its shield just before taking damage, and create distance. When Counter Strike ends, follow up with the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only if Jax moves out of range.
Jax.laning: When ganking, first find an angle to slam Jax into a wall on the inside of the lane with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Jax.phase: Afterward, buy time for Skarner to build items and look for objective control.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax jumps in and activates E Counter Strike, don’t group with your allies; wait for the area stun to end. Right after, grab Jax with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or R Impale to peel him away from your damage dealers. Use R to pull him in when allies are in position to deal damage immediately. Otherwise, buy time with Q’s slow and W’s shield.
Jax.watch: Don’t use the empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while Jax E Counter Strike is active. Your attacks will be dodged and increase its recast damage, so move outside the stun radius and wait for the duration to end. Also watch for the area stun when Jax recasts Counter Strike as he closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Then build health to strengthen Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield, but don’t stack health alone, since Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on your maximum health.
Jayce.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster before going in. Once Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun him by slamming him into a wall, then fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. Suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team when your allies can deal damage immediately.
Jayce.escape: Right after forcing Jayce to use Jayce Q To the Skies! is your window to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Jayce.fight: Don’t force your way in through Jayce’s ranged poke. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact right after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down. Once you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth, and throw a rock only if Jayce moves out of range.
Jayce.laning: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively while dodging the straight-line Jayce Q Shock Blast to either side. If you’re jungling as Skarner, clear camps safely and scale. Before ganking, pick the wall to slam Jayce into, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so choose safe farming and scaling over forced fights. Once Skarner R Impale is available in the mid game, you can gank using its suppression even without a wall. Late game, focus on using Skarner’s health and items to pull in an enemy and create a numbers advantage.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for a chance to get on Jayce after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down. If your damage dealers can attack immediately, pull Jayce into your team with Skarner R Impale and turn your body the other way just before the suppression ends to send him farther. If your allies aren’t in position to follow up, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Jayce.watch: If you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may be coming next, so dodge sideways out of its line. Hammer-form Jayce can leap in with Jayce Q To the Skies! and knock you back with Jayce E Thundering Blow, so don’t rush your engage before he uses both abilities.
