Karthus.build: Karthus’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core item order. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with maximum health, so health is useful too. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces resistance, so don’t rely on items to make it safe to cross the wall.
Karthus.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. Cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun Karthus by slamming him into a wall behind him, and fully stack Skarner P Threads of Vibration with empowered attacks while he’s stunned. When your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance or immobilize you, so instead of waiting for an ability to be down, go in when you have a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain. Close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact while dodging the blast indicator from Karthus Q Lay Waste, then grab him with Skarner R Impale.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when you see a path around Karthus W Wall of Pain and an angle to slam him into a wall. Once you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Karthus’s damage hits. Recast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to throw the rock only if Karthus moves out of range.
Karthus.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and build levels and items, but look to invade if you see a chance to disrupt Karthus’s scaling. Before ganking, find an angle to cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and slam the opponent into a wall on the inside of the lane.
Karthus.phase: Once Skarner R Impale is available in the mid game, you can gank even without a wall, so use that to secure objective control. Late game, watch for Karthus’s fast farming while buying time for Skarner to finish core items, then look for teamfights where you can pull someone in.
Karthus.teamfight: Use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team when your allies can deal damage immediately. If you don’t have that angle, buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and fight the frontline before Karthus gets within Karthus E Defile range. Even after killing Karthus, his spells continue through Karthus P Death Defied, so move away from his corpse immediately.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage if it hits you alone, so walk out when you see the blast indicator and overlap with an ally or minion if possible. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall and spend less time inside Karthus E Defile’s range. If you kill Karthus, move away immediately from his corpse, which keeps casting spells through Karthus P Death Defied, and leave enough health after a fight to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayle.build: Build magic resist first against Kayle’s damage and include Spirit Visage in your core item order. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact also benefit from health and defensive stats. If the attack speed from Kayle P Divine Ascent is a problem, consider Frozen Heart, but prioritize magic resist against Kayle.
Kayle.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to cross a wall and slam Kayle into a wall to stun her, then land the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally can attack immediately, pull Kayle toward them with Skarner R Impale. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, wait for the damage immunity to end, then focus your attacks.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so it’s a good time to engage after avoiding the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast or when that ability is down.
Kayle.fight: If Kayle uses Kayle R Divine Judgment, attack again after the damage immunity ends.
Kayle.laning: First plan a route for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam Kayle into a wall on the inside of the lane.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a route to Kayle from the flank or out of vision so she can’t keep basic attacking from the back. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when an ally can deal damage immediately, then pull Kayle into your team with Skarner R Impale. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, stall with suppression and stuns, then focus your attacks after the damage immunity ends.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resist, so avoid being hit directly. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be especially careful when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour out damage; pin her down with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale and wait out the damage immunity.

Kayn.build: Build armor first to blunt the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Don’t stack health alone, since Q deals damage based on maximum health. If you’re dueling Kayn after he transforms into the Darkin and his healing continues, build resistances first, then get Grievous Wounds.
Kayn.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Slam Kayn into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then fully stack Quaking with Skarner Q’s empowered basic attacks. When an ally can attack immediately, suppress Kayn with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them.
Kayn.escape: Don’t go in just because Kayn used Kayn Q Reaping Slash. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass is also down and hasn’t come back up, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale. Dodge the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach before engaging as well.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and look for an opening before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up. Slam Kayn into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while you’re on top of him. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage comes in to gain its shield.
Kayn.laning: Safely clear camps and scale early, but pressure Kayn’s jungle routes and objectives during his weak pre-transformation window. When ganking, first choose a wall to knock Kayn into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If the warning for Kayn E Shadow Step appears near a wall, don’t continue the fight; retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak early before transforming, so pressure his routes and objectives to delay his transformation without giving up kills. Afterward, buy time while gaining levels and items, and keep looking for suppression angles your allies can follow up on, even late game.
Kayn.watch: Avoid the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach. Getting hit can enable Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so be ready to dodge as soon as Kayn uses W from range.

Kennen.build: Kennen’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resist and include Spirit Visage in your core item order. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact also benefit from health and defensive stats.
Kennen.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster ahead of time, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and slam Kennen into a wall to stun him.
Kennen.escape: Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact as soon as Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice on Skarner, back off first and engage after the stacks disappear.
Kennen.fight: Make Kennen use Kennen E Lightning Rush, then close the gap and fight. Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval just before engaging, and land all of its empowered basic attacks once you’re on top of him. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion for its shield just before Kennen’s damage hits.
Kennen.laning: Safely clear camps and build levels and items early rather than forcing kills. When ganking Kennen’s lane, first choose a wall to knock him into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then engage from the opposite side.
Kennen.phase: Skarner’s early ganks need an angle to slam an enemy into a wall for a stun, so take them when that condition is met. Afterward, safely build items and secure control of objectives, then use your strength from completed core items.
Kennen.teamfight: Use vision to block Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s engage angles and keep allies from standing on top of one another. If Kennen goes in, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your allied damage dealers. If an ally can’t deal damage immediately, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target, so stand behind minions. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third mark and stun. When Kennen engages with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, spread out from your allies to avoid an area stun.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. Consider Frozen Heart against Kindred’s high attack speed, and if the duel goes long, build resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Kindred.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down, charge in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, slam Kindred into a wall to stun them, and land the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Once your allies move into position to attack, suppress Kindred with Skarner R Impale and pull them toward your allies.
Kindred.escape: Don’t rush in when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, since Kindred can also escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. Look for an opening after Kindred has used both Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred Q Dance of Arrows, before W comes back up, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Kindred.fight: Close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact during the window when Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down. Once you’re on top of Kindred, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Kindred moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage hits to make use of both its shield and slow.
Kindred.laning: Safely clear camps and build levels and items early, and take marked jungle camps first or ward near them. When ganking, first find an angle for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam the target into a wall.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, but Skarner is better off scaling safely than looking for early kills. In mid game, Skarner R Impale opens up more terrain for ganks. In late game, finish Skarner’s core items while delaying P Mark of the Kindred stacks to limit Kindred’s damage and range growth.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread marks you, create distance or break vision so you don’t take repeated attacks. The lower your health, the more dangerous its damage becomes, and Kindred Q Dance of Arrows can keep creating distance inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don’t stay in the fight for long.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider Frozen Heart to slow the rapid basic attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! also deals magic damage and damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Kled.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Push Kled into a wall behind him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then build Quaking stacks with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally can attack immediately, suppress Kled with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them, turning around just before it ends to increase the distance you pull him.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is available too. The opening is before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up: close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then catch him with Skarner R Impale. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, first use the brief window before it pulls you in to escape.
Kled.fight: While Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, don’t trade by taking all four basic attacks; back off, then go back in. Once you’re on top of him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion for its shield just before Kled’s damage hits. Recast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to throw a rock only when Kled moves out of range.
Kled.laning: Safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items early. When ganking, first choose a wall to knock Kled into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Kled has dismounted Skaarl, watch his Courage meter; if you can’t kill him, create distance while pressuring him so he can’t build Courage from minions or structures.
Kled.phase: Early on, avoid giving Kled an advantage and focus on Skarner’s jungle camps and objective control. As Kled’s power falls off from mid game onward, Skarner gets stronger with levels and defensive items. Draw the game out and create reliable suppression opportunities with your team.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks so you can spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming, and if you can’t stop it, stand in front as Skarner to protect your backline’s formation. If Kled starts a fight or gets onto an allied damage dealer, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and peel him off. If an ally can’t immediately damage the target you pull in, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, create distance before it pulls you in, so don’t use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact immediately; save it as an escape. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off before taking the fourth basic attack, which deals damage based on maximum health, then go back in. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can start from far away and out of vision, so keep vision on the flanks.

KSante.build: Build armor against the physical damage from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and K'Sante W Path Maker. K'Sante W Path Maker’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistance, so build health too. Health items are valuable because Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with your maximum health.
KSante.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster before going in. After K'Sante W Path Maker finishes charging, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and stun him by slamming him into a wall, then fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale, pull him toward your team, and turn your body the other way just before the duration ends.
KSante.escape: K'Sante can escape by combining W Path Maker and E Footwork, so don’t engage just because one of them is down. If both mobility tools are down and K'Sante R All Out has not come back off cooldown, you have a window to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and suppress him with R Impale. If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes’ empowered shockwave is ready, dodge it or save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
KSante.fight: Save Skarner R Impale and your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, and dodge the charge to the side. When K'Sante activates R All Out, focus damage with your allies while his armor is lower, but don’t face his increased damage and lifesteal alone. If you can stay in close combat, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to benefit from its damage based on maximum health and its slow.
KSante.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and build levels and items instead of forcing kills as Skarner.
KSante.phase: Early on, Skarner should scale safely and choose ganks with an angle to stun an enemy against a wall.
KSante.teamfight: Don’t rush to suppress K'Sante while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If your damage dealers are in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to peel K'Sante away and pull him into your team. When K'Sante activates R All Out, focus damage together while he’s more vulnerable. If the fight will last, make sure at least one person on your team has a way to apply Grievous Wounds.
KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit by several consecutive casts of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, the next shockwave can pull you in and stun you, so move out of range or save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, save your crowd control until his unstoppable effect and damage reduction end, and sidestep the charge. Don’t stand with terrain behind you when facing him, so K'Sante R All Out can’t knock you through a wall.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first to blunt the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. Consider Frozen Heart against the attack speed increase and basic attacks from Lee Sin P Flurry. Health items also increase Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield.
LeeSin.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval using a minion or jungle monster. Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike comes back up, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, slam him into a wall to stun him, then land the empowered Q basic attack. When an ally can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him in, turning around just before the duration ends.
LeeSin.escape: Lee Sin can escape by using Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike and W Safeguard/Iron Will together, so don’t engage just because one is down. In particular, while Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike is down, get on top of him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and suppress him with R Impale. The moment after Lee Sin uses W Safeguard/Iron Will to engage is also a chance to focus your damage.
LeeSin.fight: If you meet Lee Sin in the jungle early, back off instead of taking the duel. When Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike misses or is down, it’s an opportunity to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once you’re on top of him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Lee Sin moves out of range.
LeeSin.laning: Safely clear camps, build levels and items, and look for objective control early. Block the straight-line angle of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave/Resonating Strike with a minion or jungle monster, and watch for ward jumps over walls. Prioritize ganks in lanes where Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has an angle to push the enemy into a wall.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Skarner should buy time with a safe jungle path. Lee Sin falls off later while Skarner gets stronger with defensive and core items, so build advantages through objectives and lanes.
LeeSin.teamfight: If Lee Sin gets onto an allied damage dealer, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and peel him off. If an ally can attack immediately, pull the suppressed target toward them; otherwise, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. Before team fights, spread out so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn’t knock a target into your allies.
LeeSin.watch: At this point, use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage hits, then back off toward your allies. Lee Sin W Safeguard/Iron Will can cross even walls without vision, so keep your distance from walls.

Lillia.build: Build magic resist first against Lillia’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Lillia Q Blooming Blows’ true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, but Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Lillia.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, slam her into a wall behind her to stun her, and land the empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally can deal damage immediately, suppress Lillia with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward them.
Lillia.escape: The moment after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is an opportunity to close the gap, so engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Look for a time when she has no movement speed stacks after dodging her abilities, and once you catch her, use Skarner R Impale to cut off her chance to escape.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia’s abilities to prevent her from building movement speed stacks, then close the gap. Once you’re on top of her, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Lillia moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage comes in to make use of its shield and slow.
Lillia.laning: Safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items early instead of forcing kills. If you don’t know Lillia’s location, don’t walk through narrow jungle entrances or river passages where Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge.
Lillia.phase: Skarner needs a wall angle for early ganks, so it’s better to scale safely. Skarner’s defenses and damage both increase as he gets items, but it’s hard to chase Lillia if you let her build movement speed stacks.
Lillia.teamfight: Save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale to catch Lillia coming in from the flank. If an ally can deal damage to Lillia immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her into your team. Otherwise, save your ultimate and buy time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed hits you, Dream Dust is applied and you can be put to sleep by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when you have plenty of health. When you see the animation for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to avoid the center. If you’re caught by her ultimate, move to a safe place during the drowsy window before you fall asleep.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite’s main damage from Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal's Impact also scale with health and defensive stats, making defensive items efficient.
Malphite.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, knock Malphite into the wall behind him to stun him, then fully stack Quaking with empowered Q basic attacks before pulling him with Skarner R Impale when your allies can deal damage. Just before the suppression ends, turn your body around to pull him farther toward your team.
Malphite.escape: Don’t engage immediately after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you; after catching him, block his escape with Skarner R Impale.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start fighting when damage begins to hit his actual health. If you’re in close combat, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval; throw the rock only when Malphite moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands to gain a shield.
Malphite.laning: You can’t stun Malphite in an open area, so save those ganks until Skarner R Impale is available. If you can poke him at short intervals after breaking his shield, you can also prevent it from regenerating.
Malphite.phase: In the mid game, whether either champion has used their R determines when to engage.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t hit multiple people, then counterattack as soon as it is down. Don’t use Skarner R Impale to interrupt Malphite’s unstoppable dash; use it to pull a priority target toward your team when your allied damage dealer can deal damage immediately. If that condition isn’t met, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that knocks up multiple enemies around its landing point, so don’t group with allies when you can’t see where he is. Malphite Q Seismic Shard is a targeted slow that cannot be avoided behind minions; don’t start a trade immediately after it hits you.

MasterYi.build: Master Yi E Wuju Style’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistances, so build health too. Consider Frozen Heart, which lowers attack speed to slow his basic attacks and delay his next use of Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, approach with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun him by knocking him into a wall, and land the empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally is in position to attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is his only mobility tool, so immediately after he uses it is an opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, use Skarner R Impale so he cannot escape with a mobility spell.
MasterYi.fight: Immediately after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is down, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Master Yi’s damage lands to benefit from the shield.
MasterYi.laning: Rather than forcing early kills, safely clear jungle camps as Skarner and build levels and items. Master Yi is weak in the early jungle, so you can fight him when you encounter him; secure early objectives to slow his growth.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the early jungle, so safely grow as Skarner and secure early objectives. Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t delay the advantages you can gain early; later, lock him down with your team’s crowd control.
MasterYi.teamfight: When Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, stop his initial engage with the stun from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If Master Yi W Meditate is active, interrupt the healing with the immobilizing crowd control you saved. When your allied damage dealer can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Master Yi toward your team, and fight together so your ally isn’t killed while alone.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted while Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is active, so apply crowd control as soon as he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows have no effect, so you cannot create distance using the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. While Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, his basic attacks include true damage, so don’t try to withstand them for long.

MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong’s main damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces the effectiveness of the armor you’ve built while it is active. Consider Frozen Heart to reduce Wukong’s attack speed and basic attacks, but avoid relying on health alone since Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on your max health.
MonkeyKing.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. While Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, approach with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun him by knocking him into a wall, and build Quaking stacks with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally is in position to deal damage, suppress the real Wukong with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
MonkeyKing.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage when Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is down too, you have less reason to worry about his remaining mobility, so close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. If Wukong R Cyclone has just been used as well, you have an opportunity to force a fight or force action around an objective.
MonkeyKing.fight: Avoid long duels that let Wukong P Stone Skin stack up; trade briefly with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, then back off. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, don’t waste abilities on the stationary clone; watch the direction the real Wukong moves.
MonkeyKing.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to build levels and items. When ganking, first find an angle to enter over a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and knock Wukong into a wall inside the lane.
MonkeyKing.phase: Early on, Wukong P Stone Skin builds up in long fights, so safely grow as Skarner and only look for ganks with a wall angle. Later, make use of Skarner’s strength from defensive items and create opportunities to suppress Wukong with your team.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is available, don’t group with your allies; be ready to suppress Wukong with Skarner R Impale when he engages and pull him away from your allied damage dealers. Don’t mistake the stationary clone from Wukong W Warrior Trickster for the real Wukong and waste Skarner R Impale on it. Pull the real Wukong in when an ally can deal damage immediately; if that condition isn’t met, buy time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so manage the distance from outside its range. Once he’s on you, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, and the longer you fight, the more armor and healing Wukong P Stone Skin builds up.

Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser’s main ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Build some armor for his basic attack damage too, but don’t stack only health because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your max health. Grievous Wounds is also valuable against the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible.
Mordekaiser.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and you have a wall angle, catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun him by knocking him into the wall, then land an empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Mordekaiser.escape: The window to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact opens after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down. Mordekaiser has no mobility, so after catching him, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team. However, don’t engage alone if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready.
Mordekaiser.fight: Trade once or twice briefly, then back off so Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise doesn’t activate. Block his damage and create distance with a slow by using Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands. If your allies can attack immediately and Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, that’s an opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Mordekaiser.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to build levels and items. When going to Mordekaiser’s lane, first choose the wall to knock him into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Mordekaiser.phase: Early Skarner ganks depend on having a wall angle, so focus on growing safely. Skarner’s defenses and damage both improve as he completes core items, but avoid dueling alone while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn’t pull in multiple people, and manage the distance with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. When an allied damage dealer is in position to attack immediately, suppress Mordekaiser with Skarner R Impale and pull him into your team. Don’t unload your damage just after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates; focus him after the shield has worn down or been converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls in multiple enemies, so don’t group with allies in front of him. If you’ve been hit by a spell or basic attack three times and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, staying close will cost you, so back off before then. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel without your allies’ help.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus’s main damage from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so leave the affected area, and avoid relying on health alone because Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your max health.
Nasus.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Carry Nasus into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then fully stack Skarner P Threads of Vibration with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, that’s a good window to engage and land an empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Nasus has no way to create distance besides Flash, so if you have a wall angle, catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and follow up with Skarner R Impale when your allies can attack.
Nasus.fight: Engage when Nasus R Fury of the Sands is inactive and your allies can attack with you. Once you’re close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to deal damage based on max health, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Nasus’s damage lands to gain a shield. Recast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to throw the rock only when Nasus moves out of range.
Nasus.laning: Early on, pressure Nasus when he goes for last hits with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, but don’t push the lane all the way under his turret and let him stack comfortably. Let the lane push toward your side and look for ganks, choosing a wall to push Nasus into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact first.
Nasus.phase: Early on, slow Nasus’s growth by pressuring him to deny stacks and ganking when you have a wall angle. Nasus’s stacks are permanent, so he becomes harder to deal with as time goes on.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance unless you have a clear advantage, and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If an allied damage dealer is in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Nasus into your team for focused damage. If Nasus gets onto your allied damage dealer, use Skarner R Impale to peel him off as well.
Nasus.watch: If you let Nasus stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, you’ll be at a growing disadvantage as time goes on. Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so don’t enter its range alone. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, fight only when you have a clear numbers or damage advantage; otherwise, wait out its duration.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first against Nidalee’s damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact also benefit from health and defensive stats. Prioritize stepping out of the path of Nidalee Q Javelin Toss over itemization.
Nidalee.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Nidalee W Pounce is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun her by knocking her into a wall, and land an empowered attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward your team; just before it ends, turn your body around to pull her farther in.
Nidalee.escape: The opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact comes just after you bait Nidalee W Pounce. Nidalee has no crowd control, so dodge her spears and traps, confirm Pounce is down, and look for an angle to catch her. If you’ve been hit by a spear and marked for the hunt, save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale to respond to Nidalee W Pounce instead of engaging first.
Nidalee.fight: Maintain your distance while dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack, then close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact immediately after Nidalee W Pounce is down. Find an angle with a wall behind Nidalee so you can collide with the wall together. Once you’re close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Nidalee’s damage lands.
Nidalee.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to build levels and items, and check for Nidalee W Bushwhack traps in the river and at jungle entrances. For ganks in open areas, look for opportunities after Skarner R Impale is unlocked.
Nidalee.phase: Early Skarner ganks need a wall angle to stun, so dodge Nidalee’s spears and traps and focus on growing safely. Later, Skarner’s shield and damage both improve with defensive items, so complete your core items and look for opportunities to catch Nidalee with your team.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee stepped out to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and catch her with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale when Nidalee W Pounce is down. Use Skarner R Impale to pull her toward your team when an allied damage dealer can deal damage to her immediately. If you don’t have that angle, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when you’re far from Nidalee, and keep minions or your allied frontline between you. Nidalee W Bushwhack also marks you for the hunt, so check for traps at river and jungle entrances. If you’re marked, save Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale to respond when Nidalee W Pounce comes in.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, but countering his main damage takes priority. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness increases his attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart.
Nocturne.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth in advance on a minion or jungle monster. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the spell shield first with a skill such as Skarner W Seismic Bastion, then slam Nocturne into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror’s tether has broken after he uses it, you can engage with less worry about being feared. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, so break the shield first, then use Skarner R Impale.
Nocturne.fight: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth and position so there’s a wall behind the enemy, then use E to slam and stun them. While you’re close, land all your empowered Q attacks, and throw the rock only when Nocturne moves out of range.
Nocturne.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, first choose which wall to slam the target into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Nocturne.phase: Early Skarner can only stun enemies when there’s an angle to a wall, so focus on safe farming and gank when the conditions are right. As the game goes on, Skarner’s completed defensive items also benefit his shield and damage, so prepare for teamfights.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, stay with your allies so you don’t leave a target isolated. If Nocturne dives onto an allied damage dealer, peel him off with Skarner R Impale and pull him into your team. If your allies aren’t positioned to attack the target immediately, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, he can quickly approach along the trail it leaves, so don’t run straight away; turn toward an ally or turret. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, it will fear you, so hold Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to create distance. Don’t immediately use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale while Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active.

Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Get an item with Grievous Wounds early to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume.
Nunu.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval in advance using a minion or jungle monster. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, stun Nunu & Willump by knocking them into the wall behind them, and build Quaking stacks with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally is in position to deal damage, suppress them with Skarner R Impale and pull them toward your team.
Nunu.escape: Engage after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to get out of its area before the root lands. When Nunu & Willump have no spell to create distance, close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch them with Skarner R Impale.
Nunu.fight: After dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!, look for an opportunity to close in with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once you’re close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to build Quaking stacks, and don’t switch targets given the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands.
Nunu.phase: In the mid game, once Skarner R Impale is unlocked, use its suppression to look for ganks and objective control. Later, with defensive items built, hold the frontline as Skarner and look for opportunities to stop Nunu & Willump’s engage.
Nunu.teamfight: Before a fight, decide whether to use Skarner R Impale to stop Nunu & Willump’s engage or peel an enemy off your allied damage dealer. Interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero’s channel by stunning them against a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or suppressing them with Skarner R Impale. When an ally is in position to deal damage immediately, pull the suppressed target toward your team.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from a distance and knocks you up, so be especially careful when they approach from fog of war. Dodge toward the side Nunu came from instead of running in the same direction as the snowball. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, move out immediately before the follow-up root lands.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Counter the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing with health and the shield from Skarner W Seismic Bastion. Also consider Frozen Heart for Olaf’s attack speed.
Olaf.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, if you have a wall angle, carry him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to stun him, then build Quaking stacks with empowered Q basic attacks. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands, and pull him toward your team with Skarner R Impale when your allies can attack immediately.
Olaf.escape: The moment after Olaf R Ragnarok is down is an opportunity to catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale. Olaf has no spell to create distance on his own, so if you have a wall angle and your allies are in position to attack, close in with E.
Olaf.fight: Don’t force fights with Olaf early; clear camps and grow instead. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, retreat behind a wall or your allies so you don’t get hit by basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing. After R ends, if you have an angle to knock him into a wall, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while you’re close.
Olaf.laning: Prioritize safe jungle routes to build levels and items over early kills, and look for objective control as Skarner. Move in the opposite direction from where Olaf Q Undertow lands to hinder his axe retrieval and approach.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so grow safely without giving him kills. Olaf gets relatively weaker later while Skarner gets stronger as he completes items, so buy time and look for team fights.
Olaf.teamfight: If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to catch him with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale; buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. After R ends, if an allied damage dealer is in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Olaf toward your team. Just before the suppression ends, turn your body around to increase the distance you pull him.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so move in the opposite direction from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. During Olaf R Ragnarok, the stun from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and the suppression from Skarner R Impale have no effect, so create distance. If Olaf keeps hitting you with basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing during this time, R’s duration increases, and E’s true damage cannot be reduced by armor.

Ornn.build: Prioritize tank items that provide health and defenses. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with your max health, and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact also use health scaling. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance instead of focusing only on health.
Ornn.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. From an angle with a wall behind Ornn, carry him into the wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, then fully stack Skarner P Threads of Vibration with empowered attacks. If your ally can attack immediately, suppress Ornn with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your ally, then turn around just before it ends to increase the distance you pull him.
Ornn.escape: Don’t engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. Look for a window before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is available again, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then suppress him with Skarner R Impale. While Ornn W Bellows Breath has made you Brittle, delay your engage and wait for the effect to end.
Ornn.fight: Fight away from the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and terrain walls, and create distance if Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle. When trading in close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to use its max-health damage and slow. Only recast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to throw a rock when Ornn is out of range, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before his damage lands.
Ornn.laning: Early on, safely clear camps to gain levels and items instead of forcing a kill. Look for a chance to get close and interrupt Ornn when he tries to forge an item in lane. When ganking, choose the wall to slam Ornn into first, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Ornn.phase: Ornn’s damage is low early, but Skarner should also focus on safe growth over early kills. Skarner’s power rises significantly once he completes three core items, so later on, look for chances to pull a target with your team instead of engaging recklessly.
Ornn.teamfight: When Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes, move out of the line between Ornn and the spirit and avoid the recast path. If your carry is in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to stop Ornn’s engage or pull a priority target toward your team to create a numbers advantage. If your team isn’t in position, save Skarner R Impale and stall with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Ornn.watch: The pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture also counts as a wall for the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge, so stay away from the pillar and terrain walls. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, back off until the effect ends to avoid the extra damage and longer crowd control. When Ornn uses R Call of the Forge God, move out of the line between Ornn and the spirit, then avoid the path of its recast after the spirit passes.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon’s main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Even as you build armor, account for the armor penetration on Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Pantheon.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, go in with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stun Pantheon against a wall, then stack Quaking with empowered Q basic attacks. If your ally can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your ally.
Pantheon.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down; check that Pantheon R Grand Starfall has not come back up yet either. Close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact during a window when both movement tools are difficult to use, then suppress him with Skarner R Impale.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid early head-on trades and look for an opening after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. When approaching with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, position so there’s a wall behind Pantheon and stun him against it. Once you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Pantheon’s damage lands.
Pantheon.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to gain levels and items, and don’t give Pantheon a kill. When ganking Pantheon’s lane, choose the wall to slam him into first, then approach from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off later, while Skarner gets stronger as he builds items, so it’s important to avoid giving up early kills.
Pantheon.teamfight: Before a fight, decide whether to use Skarner R Impale to peel Pantheon off your carry or to pull Pantheon in first and stop his engage. If your carry is in position to attack immediately, suppress Pantheon and pull him toward your team, then turn around just before the suppression ends to send him farther in. If that condition isn’t met, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so don’t give him range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so don’t use Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval from the front. Wait until it ends or angle in from the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with max health, but Poppy Q Hammer Shock also deals damage based on your max health, so avoid building only health. Don’t spend resources specifically on magic resistance just to deal with Poppy alone.
Poppy.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun her against a wall, then stack Quaking with empowered Q basic attacks. If your ally can deal damage immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward your ally.
Poppy.escape: Immediately after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait before using Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Engage after W ends and catch her with Skarner R Impale.
Poppy.fight: Close the gap after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends or Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Once you’re on her, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Poppy moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Poppy’s damage lands to make use of its shield and slow.
Poppy.laning: Safely clear camps early to gain levels and items. Avoid positions with a wall behind you and narrow passages so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t stun you against a wall. When ganking, first choose the wall to slam her into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Poppy.phase: Afterward, buy time to build items while looking for objective control.
Poppy.teamfight: If Poppy engages, use Skarner R Impale to peel her off your carry. If there’s a target your ally can damage immediately, suppress that target and pull them into your team, then turn around just before the duration ends to send them deeper in. If you don’t have that angle, save R and stall with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Poppy.watch: If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact; wait until it ends. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second blast. When you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Quinn.build: Quinn’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider Frozen Heart against the attack speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses, and build health items to increase Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield as well.
Quinn.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion. When Quinn E Vault is down, go in with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stun her against the wall behind her, and fully stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your ally is in position to deal damage, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward your ally.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage is right after Quinn’s escape tool, Quinn E Vault, is down. Close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact then and suppress her with Skarner R Impale.
Quinn.fight: Protect your health and be cautious even with short trades before Quinn E Vault is down. Right after Quinn uses E, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Once you’re on her, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Quinn.laning: Early on, don’t spend too long within Quinn’s range; preserve your health and collect CS. Farm when Quinn P Harrier isn’t marking you, and look for a fight when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives.
Quinn.phase: In the early laning phase, preserve your health and be wary of Quinn’s range advantage. Once you’ve built health and defensive items, look to start team fights.
Quinn.teamfight: Create team fights instead of facing Quinn alone in a side lane. If Quinn comes in from the flank, catch her with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or Skarner R Impale, and pull her into your team when your allies can deal damage immediately. If that condition isn’t met, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, retreat out of range before her empowered attack hits. Stand behind minions to avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against Rammus’s main damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. Including Spirit Visage in your core build also helps Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Rammus.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Go in with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and stun Rammus against a wall. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is inactive, stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks. If your ally can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your ally.
Rammus.escape: While Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and look for an opportunity to use Skarner R Impale. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt hits you, time it so you can use your movement ability as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: Don’t use empowered attacks while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active; back off briefly. Once it ends, stack max-health damage with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner P Threads of Vibration. Activate Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Rammus’s damage lands to get its shield.
Rammus.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to gain levels and items. When ganking, first find an angle to enter over terrain with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and slam the target into a wall.
Rammus.phase: Early on, Skarner should prioritize safe growth and objective control over kills. Skarner gets stronger as he completes three core items, so buy time and take fights later.
Rammus.teamfight: When you see Rammus rolling in with Q Powerball, move away with your team from the expanded predicted landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam. Don’t trade with basic attacks while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. If he’s on your carry, peel him off with Skarner R Impale. Pull a target in only when your ally is in position to attack immediately; otherwise, stall with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him. To dodge Rammus R Soaring Slam as he comes in with increased movement speed, allow a generous margin around its predicted area. Don’t stay where he lands. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt hits you, you can’t move or use abilities, so respond from outside its range.

Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Health items also increase Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Renekton R Dominus. Against the empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice, focus on positioning so you don’t get hit instead of stacking more armor.
Renekton.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. When Renekton E Slice and Dice is down and you have a wall angle, carry him into the wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, then stack Quaking with empowered Q basic attacks. If your ally can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your ally.
Renekton.escape: The moment after you make Renekton use E Slice and Dice is Skarner’s chance to engage.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton’s Fury is empty. After Renekton has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice, fight back. In particular, if he used E to disengage, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. While you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Renekton.laning: Early on, focus on safe growth instead of forcing a kill, and don’t give Renekton a kill. Keep your distance when Renekton’s Fury is full, and poke him when he steps forward to build Fury by hitting minions. When ganking, first choose the wall to slam him into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Renekton.phase: Renekton’s value falls off from the mid game onward, so avoid giving up kills, buy time, and build defensive items.
Renekton.teamfight: If Renekton engages, first consider using Skarner R Impale to suppress him and peel him off your carry. If your ally is in position to deal damage to the target immediately, pull him into your team, then turn around just before the suppression ends to send him farther in. If that condition isn’t met, save R and stall with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton’s Fury is above half or just short of it, watch out for the empowered stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered W breaks shields first, so don’t try to block the combo with Skarner W Seismic Bastion then. If Renekton E Slice and Dice hits your minions, it unlocks a second dash, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.

Rengar.build: Rengar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider Frozen Heart because Rengar Q Savagery increases his attack speed. Health items also help because Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with Skarner’s max health.
Rengar.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and wait until Rengar W Battle Roar is down, then use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun Rengar against a wall.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Once you’ve confirmed that Rengar has also used Rengar W Battle Roar, you have less reason to worry about his crowd-control cleanse, creating an opportunity to catch him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and Skarner R Impale. Rengar has no ability that creates distance himself, so if you catch him then, he’ll have trouble escaping before using Flash.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty, right after he uses Rengar W Battle Roar. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, go in with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and stun him against a wall. While you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Rengar’s damage lands to get its shield.
Rengar.laning: Early on, safely clear jungle camps to gain levels and items instead of forcing a kill. Avoid paths beside brush where Rengar can be out of sight, and use a Control Ward to get vision in the brush. When ganking, first choose the wall to push Rengar into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Rengar.phase: Afterward, the more time you buy while building defensive items, the stronger Skarner’s shield and damage become.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your back line behind your front line and within vision, then counter Rengar’s leap. When Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or Skarner R Impale and peel him off your carry. If your ally can’t immediately damage the target you’ve suppressed, save Skarner R Impale and stall with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build his resource, so avoid the edges of brush when he’s out of sight and get vision. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike gains a root and Rengar W Battle Roar gains a crowd-control cleanse, so avoid trading then. Watch out for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, and don’t go alone when your health is low.

Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If she gets ahead, prioritize defensive items earlier and get enough health to increase Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield size.
Riven.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. While Riven Q Broken Wings is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, knock Riven into a wall to stun her, and fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Once your allies are in position to deal damage, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and drag her toward them.
Riven.escape: Don’t engage just because Riven Q Broken Wings is down. Check that Riven E Valor has also been used, and especially look to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. If Riven gets close and starts her combo, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale then.
Riven.fight: After Riven has finished using Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, start a trade before that ability comes back up. If she engages first, don’t use your crowd control too early; interrupt the rest of her combo with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before you take damage to benefit from its shield and slow.
Riven.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and build up levels and items rather than forcing kills. Riven using Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions creates a gank opportunity. Pick a wall to knock her into with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Riven.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe growth and conditional ganks that use walls rather than kills.
Riven.teamfight: If Riven gets onto an allied damage dealer, interrupt her combo and peel her off with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. If an ally can deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to drag Riven into your team, then turn your body just before the duration ends to extend the pull. If your allies aren’t in position to follow up, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings closes the gap with three dashes and a knock-up, while Riven W Ki Burst stuns Skarner after she gets close. If health has been significantly reduced, be especially wary of the missing-health damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.

Rumble.build: Rumble’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Rumble.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. Once Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield disappears, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push Rumble into a wall and stun him, then follow up with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. When an ally can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and drag him toward them.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so he’s vulnerable after using Rumble W Scrap Shield. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, don’t wait for the second; use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to create distance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan’s silence can’t interrupt Skarner R Impale once it has been used.
Rumble.fight: When Rumble has to walk forward to reach you, deal brief damage and back away to reduce your time exposed to Rumble Q Flamespitter. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait for the shield to disappear, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when you have an angle to push him into a wall.
Rumble.laning: Clear camps safely and build up your levels and items early. When ganking, pick a wall to knock Rumble into, then approach from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Save ganks in open areas without walls until you’ve learned Skarner R Impale.
Rumble.phase: Early Skarner ganks are strong when you have an angle to push Rumble into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. After that, grow safely; Skarner’s damage and shields both increase as you build defensive items.
Rumble.teamfight: When an allied damage dealer can deal damage immediately, suppress Rumble with Skarner R Impale and drag him into your team. If your allies aren’t in position, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is easier to land the closer you are, so keep your distance if you don’t have an opening to engage. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to create distance before the second shot arrives. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Sejuani’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage, while Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sejuani.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, knock her into the wall behind her to stun her, and build Skarner P Threads of Vibration stacks with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies arrive, pull her in with Skarner R Impale.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down is an opportunity to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. After Sejuani E Permafrost stuns once, its stacks can’t build again for a short time, but back away to avoid the maximum-health-based bonus basic attack that follows the stun.
Sejuani.fight: While Sejuani P Fury of the North makes her immune to slows, deal damage first to remove her armor, then use the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If you can fight in close range, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval; throw a rock only when she runs out of range.
Sejuani.laning: Clear jungle camps safely and build up levels and items early while looking for opportunities to secure objective control.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, safe growth matters more than kills for Skarner too, but Sejuani’s early kill and damage stats are low, so look for wall angles with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and opportunities to secure objectives. In the mid game, Skarner R Impale lets you gank where there are no walls. In the late game, both Skarner with core items and Sejuani with health and defensive stats are strong, so don’t miss out on growth and objectives.
Sejuani.teamfight: Before a fight, decide whether to interrupt Sejuani’s engage or peel her off an allied damage dealer. When an ally can deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Sejuani into your team; otherwise, buy time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Sejuani.watch: Move sideways to dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison when you see their wind-up. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath’s first hit lands, get out of range before the second hit. Back away as Sejuani E Permafrost stacks build up, including from attacks by allied melee champions.

Sett.build: Build armor first to counter Sett’s main damage. Lowering his attack speed to reduce the number of basic attacks you take is also effective. Sett Q Knuckle Down and Sett R The Show Stopper hurt more against targets with a lot of health, so be wary of building only health.
Sett.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push Sett into the wall behind him and stun him, then stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks during the stun. When an ally can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward them, turning your body the other way just before the duration ends.
Sett.escape: The window to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is while Sett R The Show Stopper, his engage tool, is down. Avoid positioning where allies or minions are on both sides of Sett, so Sett E Facebreaker can’t stun you, then engage.
Sett.fight: Stay close and land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, but back away briefly after dealing enough damage for Sett to use Sett W Haymaker. Don’t use Skarner W Seismic Bastion before engaging; use it just before damage lands to get its shield.
Sett.laning: Clear camps safely and build up your levels and items rather than forcing kills early. When ganking, pick a wall to push Sett into, then engage from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Sett.phase: Early on, Skarner should grow safely and look for ganks where he can push enemies into walls to stun them. After that, build levels and defensive items while looking for opportunities to secure objective control.
Sett.teamfight: Before a fight, decide whether to use Skarner R Impale to stop Sett from engaging or to peel him off an allied damage dealer. If an ally can attack immediately, pull the suppressed target into your team to create a numbers advantage. Otherwise, save your ultimate and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous just after Sett takes damage. After dealing damage, back away briefly, and when Haymaker comes out, step sideways from the center of its indicator to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so don’t stand with Sett between you and an ally or minion.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Also build health to avoid the low-health threshold where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals increased damage.
Shaco.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Once Shaco Q Deceive is down, use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to knock Shaco into a wall and stun him. Land an empowered Q basic attack, then pull him toward your allies with Skarner R Impale once they’ve arrived.
Shaco.escape: Shaco Q Deceive is his way to create distance, so close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact right after he uses it. If you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box is along your approach, secure vision first to avoid its fear before going in.
Shaco.fight: The moment after Shaco appears using Shaco Q Deceive is an opportunity to catch him, so engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when your allies can attack with you. Once you’re close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before damage lands to gain its shield.
Shaco.laning: Rather than forcing kills early, clear camps safely and maintain vision at your allied jungle entrances. Check areas around objectives first if you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box is there, and only try ganks when you have an angle to knock the enemy into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, so deny him kills while taking camps and objectives. Once Skarner R Impale is available in the mid game, more areas become viable for ganks. Buy time to complete your core items: Skarner grows stronger, while Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off late.
Shaco.teamfight: The moment Shaco appears using Shaco Q Deceive, focus your damage on the real Shaco with your allies and catch him with Skarner R Impale, dragging him into your team. If your allied damage dealers can’t attack immediately, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. Watch the health bar’s response so you don’t waste damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone.
Shaco.watch: Beware of Shaco W Jack In The Box fear in bushes without vision and around objectives; check first with Oracle Lens or a Control Ward. If Shaco Q Deceive gets behind you, his empowered basic attack is dangerous, so keep your back to a wall or face your allies. Back away from the explosion and boxes where Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone dies.

Shen.build: The time spent locked down by Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus your resistance on only one type. Shen Q Twilight Assault increases attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart, but avoid building only health because of its maximum-health-based damage.
Shen.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and knock Shen into the wall behind him to stun him. After Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, land empowered basic attacks. When your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and drag him toward them.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is an opening to engage. If Shen R Stand United is also not yet available again, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale. If only Shen E Shadow Dash is down, check whether Shen R Stand United is still available.
Shen.fight: Engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, don’t rush your empowered basic attacks; continue them with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval after the zone ends. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before taking damage to gain its shield and slow Shen.
Shen.laning: Aim for lane priority rather than kills early, and push the wave to keep Shen occupied with CS. Then, when Shen intervenes in another lane with Shen R Stand United, you can take advantage of the lane he left. Alert your team immediately if Shen disappears or you see the channeling animation for Shen R Stand United.
Shen.phase: Use Shen’s weak laning early to gain priority, but avoid forcing an engage if you don’t have an angle to knock him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Late game, once Skarner has core items, pull targets during fights where your allies can follow up.
Shen.teamfight: Watch for Shen E Shadow Dash’s engage, and peel Shen off an allied damage dealer with Skarner R Impale. If your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, drag the suppressed target into your team, turning your body the other way just before the duration ends to pull him farther in. If your allies can’t follow up, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’ll be hit by empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of Shen’s spirit blade as it returns to him to reduce the damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, hold Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered basic attacks briefly.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Also get armor to handle the physical damage from her basic attacks. Shyvana Q Emberstrike’s true damage can’t be mitigated by resistances, but it also deals maximum-health-based damage, so don’t lean too heavily on stacking health.
Shyvana.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster.
