Wait for Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to land, then use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push her into a wall and stun her, followed by empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally can deal damage immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and drag her toward them.
Shyvana.escape: Crowd control doesn’t affect Shyvana while she flies with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so engage after she lands. When her Fury bar is empty or her transformation ends, it’s an opportunity to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and catch her with Skarner R Impale. Shyvana has no ability to create distance, so engage when you have an angle to push her into a wall.
Shyvana.fight: Fight when Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty or when her dragon form ends and she returns to human form. Use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to push her toward the wall behind her and stun her, then land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while close. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Shyvana’s damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow.
Shyvana.laning: Clear camps safely and build up levels and items early, while looking to secure camp and objective control before Shyvana stacks Shyvana P Scalemail. Pressure her or start objectives when her Fury bar is empty; don’t attack first when it’s full.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, Shyvana has fewer Shyvana P Scalemail stacks, making it a good time to pressure her, but Skarner should still prioritize safe growth and objective control over forcing kills. In the late game, her permanent stacks make the matchup increasingly unfavorable over time, so it’s important to limit her growth from early on.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread your formation widely so several allies aren’t hit together by Shyvana’s dragon-form area attacks. If Shyvana lands with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and gets onto an allied damage dealer, peel her off with Skarner R Impale and pull her into your team if your allies can attack immediately from that position. If that condition isn’t met, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so don’t try to interrupt her engage; catch her after she lands with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. In dragon form, Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst can hit multiple people, so spread out widely from your allies. Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid staying close and taking hits for too long.

Singed.build: Singed’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Singed E Fling deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Singed.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Avoid Singed W Mega Adhesive, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and knock Singed into a wall to stun him. Follow with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When an ally can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and drag him toward them.
Singed.escape: The opportunity to engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact comes after you dodge Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling, or after he has used them. Singed has no ability to create distance, so once you catch him, you can continue the suppression with Skarner R Impale. If you’re standing on the adhesive, don’t attempt a charge; go around it first.
Singed.fight: If you have an angle to push Singed into a wall while avoiding Singed W Mega Adhesive, engage with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact. Once close, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Singed runs out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion for a shield when you take damage, and don’t chase Singed along Singed Q Poison Trail unless you can finish him for sure.
Singed.phase: Skarner gets stronger as he completes core items, but Singed also becomes harder to catch, so late game, focus on suppression and your allies’ concentrated damage instead of chasing.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed runs into your team, lock him down with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale, and don’t commit your team to chasing him. When there’s a target your allies can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull them into your team and create a numbers advantage. If you don’t have that angle, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase Singed when he’s low on health through Singed Q Poison Trail. Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can’t be used on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around it. If Singed has his back to your allies, check your position; standing in front of him can let Singed E Fling throw you into the enemy team.

Sion.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield scales with your max health, but Sion P Glory in Death also deals damage based on max health, so avoid building only health.
Sion.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash or forcing him to use it early, stun him by knocking him into a wall behind him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Stack Quaking with empowered attacks during the stun, then suppress Sion with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team when your allies are in position to deal damage.
Sion.escape: Engaging after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash or forcing him to use it early also reduces the risk of being crowd controlled. Once Skarner R Impale lands, it’s hard for Sion to escape.
Sion.fight: After sidestepping Sion Q Decimating Smash as it charges, stack Quaking on one target with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. While you’re close, land all the empowered basic attacks; when Sion moves out of range, recast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to throw a rock. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow.
Sion.laning: Safely clear camps early to build levels and items. When ganking Sion, first find an angle to push him into an inner wall of the lane with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Even if you can’t kill him, letting him farm freely increases his max health, so disrupt his farming or make plays in other lanes.
Sion.phase: Early Skarner ganks depend on whether Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact can stun Sion against a wall, so focus on safely scaling. As the game goes on, Sion keeps increasing his max health through farming, while Skarner grows stronger as he completes items. Don’t let Sion farm unchallenged and drag the game out.
Sion.teamfight: Plan a path to sidestep the straight-line engage from Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, and decide before a fight whether to use Skarner R Impale to peel Sion off an allied damage dealer. If your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress Sion and pull him into your team. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. After Sion falls, reposition to avoid his attacks while reanimated by Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.watch: The longer Sion Q Decimating Smash charges, the more dangerous its knock-up and stun become. When you see it charging, sidestep or move in close to pressure Sion into using it early. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is hard to dodge forward or backward, so avoid narrow paths and move to the side. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor if it hits you, so avoid it whenever possible.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Q Tongue Lash, and W Abyssal Dive, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. If Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and E Thick Skin’s healing make the duel drag on, get grievous wounds next. Tahm Kench R Devour deals damage based on max health, so be wary of building a lot of health alone.
TahmKench.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Knock Tahm Kench into a wall behind him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, and build Skarner P Threads of Vibration stacks with empowered attacks during the stun. When your allies are in position to attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has a harder time engaging or escaping, giving you a chance to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Choose a time when Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks, and don’t stay in range long enough to give Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash a chance to stun you. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before incoming damage to benefit from its shield and slow.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin converts damage into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you poke and back off. Engage when Tahm Kench has no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks and you can focus damage with your allies. While fighting in range, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Tahm Kench moves out of range.
TahmKench.laning: Safely clear camps early to build levels and items, and prioritize lanes where you have a wall angle to engage on Tahm Kench. For a gank, pick the wall you’ll push him into first, then approach from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
TahmKench.phase: Early on, focus on safely scaling rather than rushing kills, and look for ganks where you have a wall angle. As Skarner completes items, his damage and shield grow stronger, so in the mid and late game look for chances to pull a target protected by Tahm Kench when your allies are nearby.
TahmKench.teamfight: Pressure the carry Tahm Kench is protecting instead of blindly attacking him first, but account for the chance that Tahm Kench R Devour is ready and can swallow your target, making them untargetable. When your allied damage dealers can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team. If an ally is swallowed, focus your damage on Tahm Kench. If there’s no opening to engage, buy time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and W Seismic Bastion.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. Taking a third basic attack or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash opens up opportunities for both a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies to avoid the area knock-up.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build. Health and defensive stats also help Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Taliyah.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. From an angle that avoids the field of rocks from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stun Taliyah by knocking her into a wall, then build Quaking stacks with empowered attacks. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress her with Skarner R Impale and pull her toward your team, turning your body in the opposite direction just before the duration ends.
Taliyah.escape: Find an opening to engage after dodging Taliyah E Unraveled Earth’s field of rocks and Taliyah W Seismic Shove, or after both abilities are down. If Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall isn’t back up yet, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and look for a chance to suppress her with Skarner R Impale. To prevent Taliyah from escaping, keep dealing damage so she can’t use Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall.
Taliyah.fight: While Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is active, don’t charge across it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact; find a way around. Approach while sidestepping Taliyah Q Threaded Volley, and use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow. Once in range, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Taliyah moves out of range.
Taliyah.laning: Safely clear camps early to build levels and items, and look for control over objectives. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, watch for her to use Taliyah P Rock Surfing and Taliyah R Weaver’s Wall to intervene in another lane, and back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Early on, Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact can stun only when there’s an angle to knock the target into a wall, so focus on safely scaling. As you complete core items, your defensive stats also contribute to your shield and damage, so buy time and keep scaling.
Taliyah.teamfight: If your allied damage dealers are in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. Choose an engage path that doesn’t cross the field of rocks from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Taliyah.watch: You will still be stunned if you charge across the field of rocks with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, so check the ground before engaging. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change its cast direction, so sidestep it.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Including Spirit Visage in your core build helps you withstand Teemo’s damage while also strengthening Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and the damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If the attack speed from Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare is a problem, consider Frozen Heart as well.
Teemo.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stun him by knocking him into a wall, and build Skarner P Threads of Vibration stacks with empowered attacks. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, you have an opening to engage and follow up with empowered attacks. If Teemo W Move Quick has also been used, take the opportunity to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Once you’ve caught Teemo, prevent his escape with Skarner R Impale.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, stun Teemo by knocking him into a wall, and use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while the blind is absent. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before incoming damage to benefit from its shield and slow.
Teemo.laning: Early on, safely clear camps to build levels and items instead of forcing a kill. When entering Teemo’s lane, pick the wall you’ll push him into first, then engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact from the opposite side.
Teemo.phase: Early on, focus on safely scaling instead of forcing kills, and look for wall angles for ganks so Teemo doesn’t get too much time to place mushrooms. Skarner grows stronger as he completes core items, but Teemo R Noxious Trap also lasts a long time, so check the path to objectives.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages. If your allies are in position to deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team and create a numbers advantage. If that condition isn’t met, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart blocks basic attacks, so don’t try to land empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while blinded. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even if you’re hit by only one basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to commit. Also watch bushes where you have no vision where Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare can hide him, and narrow paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be placed.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks, and consider Frozen Heart to reduce the attack speed Trundle gains from Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage and steals resistances, so getting out of its range should take priority over stacking more resistance. Keep in mind that building a lot of health alone also increases the damage from Trundle R Subjugate, which is based on max health.
Trundle.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Charge with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact so there’s a wall behind Trundle, then stun him by knocking him into it. While he’s stunned, build Skarner P Threads of Vibration stacks with empowered Q attacks. When your allies can attack immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Trundle.escape: Wait outside Trundle W Frozen Domain until it expires, and dodge Trundle E Pillar of Ice before engaging. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale.
Trundle.fight: Don’t fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain; back out, then re-engage. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t stand and fight him head-on for long. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands. Once in range, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw a rock only when Trundle moves out of range.
Trundle.laning: Early on, safely clear camps to build levels and items instead of forcing a kill. When ganking, first choose a wall to push the enemy into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then engage from the opposite side. Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so if you’ve damaged him, don’t let the fight drag on; take an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: Once Skarner has completed items, look to force team fights around objectives, and don’t face Trundle alone in a side lane, even late in the game.
Trundle.teamfight: While Trundle R Subjugate is active, target someone else or create distance instead of focusing Trundle. If your allied damage dealers are in position to attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target into your team and create a numbers advantage. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Trundle.watch: On Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed, movement speed, and healing received increase, so back out of the area and wait out its duration. In narrow paths, Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape route, so move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on max health and steals armor and magic resistance, so create distance or target someone else while it’s active.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s basic attacks and attack speed, and consider Frozen Heart. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals a mix of physical and magic damage, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all of it. Both abilities deal damage based on max health, so be careful about building a lot of health alone.
Udyr.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. After Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect ends and he uses his mobility, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and stun him by knocking him into a wall. Build Quaking stacks with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, then suppress Udyr with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his only mobility ability, so right after you force him to use it is your opening to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If you’ve already taken one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, counterattack or escape while he can’t immediately stun the same target again.
Udyr.fight: Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, follow up with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and don’t give him a chance to heal. While in range, use all the empowered basic attacks, and throw a rock only when Udyr moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow.
Udyr.laning: Safely clear jungle camps early to build levels and items, and track Udyr’s path with vision at key routes and jungle entrances. When Udyr is out of sight, make sure your allied lanes don’t push forward.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Skarner needs an angle to knock an enemy into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun them, so focus on a safe jungle route and ganks when the conditions are right. Defensive items also increase Skarner’s damage and shield, so buy time to complete your core items.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to force a kill on Udyr through his defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield. If Udyr runs at an allied damage dealer, you can peel him off with Skarner R Impale after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect ends. If your allies are in position to attack immediately, pull a priority target to create a numbers advantage. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Udyr.watch: Be careful of the stun on Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s first hit right after he activates it. Immobilizing effects don’t work during Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s Awakened effect, so don’t use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or Skarner R Impale before it ends. Also watch out for the max-health-based damage and empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, and the slow and max-health-based damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm.

Urgot.build: Build armor first because Urgot’s main damage is physical. Since Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on max health, don’t build a lot of health alone; also consider Urgot R Fear Beyond Death’s execute threshold when deciding how much total health to get.
Urgot.combo: Before engaging, use a minion or jungle monster to activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When Urgot E Disdain is down, push him into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, then build Quaking stacks with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. When your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress him with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility ability, so right after he uses it is your chance to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. When Urgot Q Corrosive Charge is incoming, don’t insist on engaging; decide immediately whether to escape with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Urgot.fight: Staying near Urgot lets his leg cannons damage you repeatedly, so avoid long trades head-on. Right after Urgot uses E Disdain, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and stun him by knocking him into a wall. While in range, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Urgot.laning: Early on, safely clear camps to build levels and items instead of forcing a kill on Urgot. When ganking, find an angle to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact so there’s a wall behind Urgot.
Urgot.phase: Early on, melee champions have a hard time beating Urgot head-on, so focus on safely scaling. Buy time to complete your items, but don’t stay in range and fight for long because of Urgot P Echoing Flames.
Urgot.teamfight: Hold the frontline to block angles where Urgot E Disdain could reach your allied damage dealers in the back. If your allies can deal damage immediately, suppress Urgot with Skarner R Impale and pull him toward your team. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on max health, so don’t fight beside him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you are strongly slowed and become a target for Urgot W Purge, so decide immediately whether to escape with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when you see it coming. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execute threshold.

Vi.build: Vi’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider Frozen Heart against her basic attacks and attack speed. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Vi.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and slam Vi into the wall behind her, then follow up with empowered Q attacks during the stun. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress Vi and pull her toward your team when your allies can deal damage immediately.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her mobility ability, so right after you force her to use it is your window to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If Vi R Cease and Desist has started, don’t use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or R Impale while she’s charging in; wait until she lands and the knock-up ends. Shield yourself with Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage hits.
Vi.fight: If Vi comes in with P Blast Shield active, trade after the shield has been removed. Don’t let Vi W Denting Blows keep hitting you for long; fight briefly, then create distance. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker or immediately after forcing her to use it.
Vi.laning: Early on, don’t force kills; safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items. When ganking during the window after Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, enter from over a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and find an angle to slam the opponent into the wall behind them.
Vi.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe growth instead of rushing for kills, and gank only after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker when you have a wall angle. Later, take advantage of Skarner getting stronger as he completes items to prepare for objectives and teamfights.
Vi.teamfight: Vi R Cease and Desist can target an allied carry, so move together to keep the carry within range of protective abilities. After Vi lands and the knock-up ends, suppress her with Skarner R Impale to pull her away from your carry. If your allies aren’t positioned to deal damage immediately, save R and buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and W Seismic Bastion.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Q Vault Breaker, it deals more damage, so move backward or sideways to dodge it as soon as you see her stance. Vi W Denting Blows reduces a target’s armor and increases her attack speed as she keeps hitting the same target, so avoid extended fights. While Vi is charging in with R Cease and Desist, don’t use forced movement; respond after she lands and the knock-up ends.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Viego E Harrowed Path increases his attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart. If an extended duel makes healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King a problem, build resistances first, then get healing reduction.
Viego.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Push Viego into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, then build Quaking stacks with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. If both Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker have been spent and are still on cooldown, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and catch him with Skarner R Impale. If Viego is charging W Spectral Maw, sidestep, then interrupt it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when you have a wall angle.
Viego.fight: Look for an engage when both Viego W Spectral Maw and Viego R Heartbreaker are down. Once you’re on him, use all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw the rock only when Viego moves out of range. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before Viego’s damage lands to make use of its shield.
Viego.laning: Early on, safely clear camps and build levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, line up a wall behind the enemy, then push them into it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun them. If you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path in a passage, place a Control Ward or take another route, and don’t push the lane in that direction.
Viego.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe growth instead of rushing for kills, and it’s important not to give Viego a kill. As the game goes on, Skarner’s damage and shields grow with defensive items, so look to take control of objectives.
Viego.teamfight: If your allied carries can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull Viego into your team and create a chance to kill him. Otherwise, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. If an ally has been killed, push Viego away or lock him down so he can’t reach the remaining wraiths with Viego P Sovereign’s Domination.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more he charges it, so sidestep when you see him charging. If you have an angle to collide with a wall, stun him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to interrupt the charge; Skarner R Impale can also stop it. When your health is low, back away because Viego R Heartbreaker can target you.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the attack speed from Volibear P The Relentless Storm is a problem, consider Frozen Heart. Also consider a healing reduction item against the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul, but be cautious about stacking health alone because Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your maximum health.
Volibear.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Push Volibear into the wall behind him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to stun him, then fully stack Quaking with empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can deal damage immediately, then turn around just before the effect ends.
Volibear.escape: Don’t engage just because Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down; look for the window before Volibear R Stormbringer returns. If stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm have also fallen off, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and suppress him with Skarner R Impale. When Volibear chases you with Q Thundering Smash, cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact or move toward your allies instead of running straight away.
Volibear.fight: Don’t fight while Volibear approaches with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm; wait for them to fall off. Move sideways out of the marked area of Volibear E Sky Splitter, and shield yourself with Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before incoming damage lands. If you can fight in melee range, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, and throw the rock only when Volibear moves out of range.
Volibear.laning: Early on, safely clear camps and build levels and items. When ganking, first choose which wall to slam the enemy into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Skarner can stun with a gank only when there’s an angle to collide the enemy with a wall, so focus on a safe jungle route. Later, make use of Skarner’s health scaling and maximum-health-based shield, and buy time to complete three core items before fighting.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear comes in with fully stacked Volibear P The Relentless Storm, don’t immediately take the fight. If your allied carries can deal damage immediately, use Skarner R Impale to interrupt Volibear’s engage or peel him off a carry he’s reached and pull him toward you. Without that setup, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Volibear.watch: Avoid fighting while Volibear has stacks of attack speed from P The Relentless Storm; engage after the stacks fall off. If he activates Q Thundering Smash and runs at you, watch for the stun on his empowered basic attack; stay outside his attack range or cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move sideways to avoid its damage and slow.

Warwick.build: Warwick’s main ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core build. His basic attacks also deal damage, so armor is useful, and consider Frozen Heart against the attack speed increase from Warwick W Blood Hunt. If Warwick’s healing becomes a problem in a long duel, build resistances first, then consider Executioner’s Calling.
Warwick.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl goes off, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and collide Warwick with a wall to stun him, then land empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval during the stun. When your allies are in position to deal damage, use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward them.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Before Warwick R Infinite Duress returns, use the window after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has gone off to close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Then suppress him with Skarner R Impale to prevent him from escaping.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t unload your damage; engage after the fear goes off. Once you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval to make use of its damage based on maximum health, and throw the rock only when Warwick moves out of range. Gain a shield and apply a slow with Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands.
Warwick.laning: Early on, Skarner should safely clear camps and build levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, first choose which wall to push Warwick into with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then approach from the opposite side.
Warwick.phase: Later, survive with defensive items, make use of damage based on maximum health, and look for a chance to peel Warwick off your team in teamfights.
Warwick.teamfight: If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits an allied carry, counterattack while Warwick is held in place, and use Skarner R Impale if needed to peel him off your ally. Before using Skarner R Impale to pull Warwick in, check that your allies can deal damage immediately. If they aren’t in position, save the suppression and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Warwick.watch: When your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location and increases his movement and attack speed, so don’t stay in the jungle with depleted health. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he greatly reduces incoming damage and can trigger fear early; back off, then re-engage after the fear. Warwick R Infinite Duress can fly in from long range and suppress you, so watch bushes without vision and areas beyond walls too.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao’s main damage. He relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so consider Frozen Heart. Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard deals damage based on the target’s current health, so stacking health alone is less effective.
XinZhao.combo: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval ahead of time on a minion or jungle monster. After Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, slam Xin Zhao into a wall to stun him, and fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you make Xin Zhao use E Audacious Charge is your chance to engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Conversely, if you’ve been hit twice by empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, escape with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact before the third hit. If you dodge the stab from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways and avoid the challenge, you also deny him the increased dash range.
XinZhao.fight: Activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval before engaging, and approach with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. Stun him when you have a wall behind him, then follow up with empowered attacks. While you’re on him, land all the empowered basic attacks, and throw the rock only when Xin Zhao moves out of range.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, safely clear jungle camps and build levels and items. When ganking, choose the wall to slam the enemy into first, then approach from the opposite side with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, Skarner’s ganks depend on having a wall angle, so focus on growth instead of taking risky fights with Xin Zhao. Later, Skarner gets stronger as he completes items, and the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends is your chance to catch him.
XinZhao.teamfight: When Xin Zhao engages, don’t stand too close to your allies, so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split up your whole formation at once. Use Skarner R Impale to stop Xin Zhao’s engage or pull him away from an allied carry he has reached. If your allies can deal damage immediately, pull the suppressed Xin Zhao into your team.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways. If you’ve been hit twice by empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, move out of range with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact before the third attack knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage from allies outside spear range won’t affect him.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Health items also increase the size of Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield. Remember that armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Engage with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and collide Yasuo with a wall to stun him, then build Quaking stacks with empowered Q attacks. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws the tornado from Q Steel Tempest is your chance to engage. Before Yasuo R Last Breath returns, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, then catch Yasuo with Skarner R Impale so he can’t use E Sweeping Blade. Don’t engage just because one mobility ability is down.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with one hit, then start the real fight. After dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, or immediately after he throws it, follow up with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, which you activated ahead of time. While in melee range, keep attacking the same target to build Quaking stacks and land the final empowered Q hit.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, safely clear camps and build levels and items instead of forcing kills. When ganking, first check which minions Yasuo could use as stepping stones with E Sweeping Blade and where the wall to slam him into is.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe growth and ganks with a wall angle instead of kills. Later, build health and defensive items, survive with Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and peel Yasuo off your team in teamfights.
Yasuo.teamfight: If Yasuo reaches an allied carry, suppress him with Skarner R Impale to peel him off. When your allies can attack immediately, pull Yasuo toward them to create an opportunity for focused damage. Otherwise, save R and buy time with the slows from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and W Seismic Bastion.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks enemies up. When you hear the stacking sound and see the effects, don’t stand in a line with Yasuo; sidestep. If Yasuo approaches by dashing through minions with E Sweeping Blade, use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before his damage lands to benefit from its shield and slow.

Yone.build: Get movement speed first to make it easier to leave the telegraphed areas of Yone Q Mortal Steel and W Spirit Cleave. Yone deals mixed damage, so build both physical and magic resistance, and don’t stack health alone given the maximum-health-based damage on Yone W Spirit Cleave. Health from defensive items also helps Skarner W Seismic Bastion’s shield and Skarner’s damage.
Yone.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Cross terrain with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and collide Yone with a wall to stun him, then fully stack Quaking with empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can attack immediately, and turn around just before it ends to increase the distance you pull him.
Yone.escape: Yone can escape in sequence with Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, and Yone R Fate Sealed, so don’t chase just because one is down. In particular, use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact to close the gap during a window before Yone R Fate Sealed returns and when the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel isn’t ready. If Yone enters first with E Soul Unbound, you can stop his return with the suppression from Skarner R Impale or a stun from Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact that collides him with a wall.
Yone.fight: When the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready, create distance first; after Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to use Skarner’s immobilizing effects. Stun him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact when you have an angle to push him into a wall, then land all the empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval while you’re on him. Only cast Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval again to throw the rock after Yone moves out of range.
Yone.laning: In the jungle, safely clear camps and build levels and items; when ganking, approach so there’s a wall behind Yone. If Yone is repeatedly using Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare the tornado, don’t go straight in; wait for the stacks to disappear. On a lane with no angle to slam him into a wall, look for a chance after Skarner R Impale is available.
Yone.phase: Early on, focus on safe growth and ganks with a wall angle. From midgame, once Skarner R Impale is available, you can suppress Yone even in open terrain; later, with defensive items, focus on peeling Yone off your team alongside your allies.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and check that you aren’t alone at the very back along Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. If Yone dives onto an allied carry, peel him off with Skarner R Impale, and pull him into your team when your allies can attack immediately. If those conditions aren’t met, save Skarner R Impale and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Yone.watch: The tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel dashes and knocks you up, so if Yone keeps using Q on minions to prepare it, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Damage taken after Yone enters with E Soul Unbound is partly dealt again when he returns, so if health has decreased, heal before he returns or get out of range. In teamfights, spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit together by Yone W Spirit Cleave.

Yorick.build: Build armor first because Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage. Basic attacks also make up a large part of his damage, so reducing his attack speed helps. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Yorick.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth on a minion or jungle monster. Pull Yorick with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and collide him with the wall behind him to stun him, then land empowered attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth. Use Skarner R Impale to suppress him and pull him toward your team when your allies can deal damage immediately.
Yorick.escape: The moment after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses is your chance to engage. Yorick has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and follow up with Skarner R Impale. If Yorick W Dark Procession blocks your approach, attack the wall or cross it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.
Yorick.fight: Before engaging, clear the Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist, using Smite if you have it. After Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, close the gap with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and catch Yorick. Use Skarner W Seismic Bastion just before the damage lands to benefit from both the shield and slow.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Skarner should focus on safe camps and ganks with a wall angle instead of forcing kills. Later, Skarner’s shield and damage grow with defensive items, so weather Yorick’s side lane pressure, then regroup with your team and look for objectives.
Yorick.teamfight: If Yorick brings the Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist, clear them first to reduce the damage you take. If your allied carries can attack immediately, use Skarner R Impale to pull a priority target toward them and create a numbers advantage. Otherwise, buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth and Skarner W Seismic Bastion.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so dodge the projectile’s path. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it or cross it with Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.

Zac.build: Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Build Spirit Visage as a core item, and avoid stacking only health because Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health.
Zac.combo: Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval on a minion or jungle monster. Interrupt Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s charge with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, or engage right after Zac uses E and slam him into a wall to stun him.
Zac.escape: The moment after you make Zac use E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to close the distance. If Zac is charging E, don’t wait for him to land; interrupt it with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale.
Zac.fight: Start a fight after interrupting Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s charge or baiting him into using it. Before engaging, activate Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval, then use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact to slam Zac into a wall and stun him before following up with empowered attacks.
Zac.laning: Early on, farm jungle camps safely to gain levels and items instead of forcing kills.
Zac.phase: Early Skarner ganks need an angle to slam the target into a wall for a stun, so focus on farming safely. Skarner gets stronger later with core items, so check whether Zac’s revive passive is available as you prepare to contest objectives.
Zac.teamfight: After interrupting Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s charge or withstanding his engage, use Skarner R Impale to peel Zac off an allied damage dealer. If your allies are positioned to attack immediately, pull Zac into your team and focus him down. If they aren’t, save R and buy time with the slow from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner W Seismic Bastion, while stepping on Zac’s blobs to prevent him from healing.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge, and its landing can knock you up, so watch for him charging behind a wall. As soon as you see it, interrupt the charge with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. Step on Zac’s dropped blobs to destroy them and prevent him from healing.
